WITH local_differences AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School,
        s.DOCType,
        f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment_difference
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT School, DOCType
FROM local_differences
WHERE enrollment_difference > (
    SELECT AVG(enrollment_difference)
    FROM local_differences
);

SELECT
    s.School,
    ROUND(f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`, 6) AS eligible_meal_rate
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DOCType = 'Unified School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
  / SUM(CASE WHEN DOCType = 'Elementary School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Orange'
  AND StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND DOCType IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District')
  AND CDSCode NOT LIKE '%0000000';

SELECT s.MailStreet, s.School
FROM satscores AS ss
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.rtype = 'S'
  AND ss.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ss.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
  AND "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" < 0.0018;

SELECT s.School,
       f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0
           / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0)
           AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-9';

SELECT f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" * 100 AS "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)",
       f."District Code"
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine';

SELECT DISTINCT email
FROM (
    SELECT AdmEmail1 AS email
    FROM schools
    WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
      AND City = 'San Bernardino'
      AND DOCType = 'Unified School District'
      AND SOCType = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)'
      AND OpenDate >= '2009-01-01'
      AND OpenDate < '2011-01-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT AdmEmail2
    FROM schools
    WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
      AND City = 'San Bernardino'
      AND DOCType = 'Unified School District'
      AND SOCType = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)'
      AND OpenDate >= '2009-01-01'
      AND OpenDate < '2011-01-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT AdmEmail3
    FROM schools
    WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
      AND City = 'San Bernardino'
      AND DOCType = 'Unified School District'
      AND SOCType = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)'
      AND OpenDate >= '2009-01-01'
      AND OpenDate < '2011-01-01'
)
WHERE email IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(email) <> '';

SELECT s.NCESSchool
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.CDSCode IN ('1751010130583', '1612910137588', '1611760134270')
  AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" = (
      SELECT MAX(f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
      FROM frpm AS f2
      WHERE f2.CDSCode IN ('1751010130583', '1612910137588', '1611760134270')
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(s.NumTstTakr, 0)), 2) AS average_sat_test_takers
FROM schools AS sc
LEFT JOIN satscores AS s
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.CharterNum = '0756'
  AND sc.MailCity = 'San Diego';

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        s.School,
        s.GSserved,
        CASE
            WHEN s.GSserved LIKE 'P-%' THEN 0
            WHEN s.GSserved LIKE 'TK-%' THEN 1
            WHEN s.GSserved LIKE 'K-%' THEN 2
            ELSE CAST(substr(s.GSserved, 1, instr(s.GSserved, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER) + 2
        END AS starting_grade_rank
    FROM schools AS s
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
        ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
      AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
      AND s.EILName IN ('High School', 'Elementary-High Combination')
      AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
      AND s.GSserved LIKE '%12'
      AND (sat.cds IS NULL OR sat.NumTstTakr = 0)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        School,
        GSserved,
        starting_grade_rank,
        MIN(starting_grade_rank) OVER () AS earliest_grade_rank
    FROM eligible
)
SELECT School, GSserved
FROM ranked
WHERE starting_grade_rank = earliest_grade_rank
ORDER BY School;

SELECT s.School AS SchoolName, s.MailStreet AS MailingStreetAddress
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
  AND ss.rtype = 'S'
  AND ss.AvgScrRead = (
      SELECT MAX(ss2.AvgScrRead)
      FROM schools AS s2
      JOIN satscores AS ss2 ON ss2.cds = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
        AND ss2.rtype = 'S'
  );

SELECT s.City
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.CDSCode = '1611920113902'
  AND s.County = 'Alameda'
  AND s.EILCode = 'HS'
  AND f."Low Grade" = '9'
  AND f."High Grade" = '12'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2';

SELECT s.School, s.City
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.EILCode = 'HS'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
  AND CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) > 9
ORDER BY s.School;

SELECT s.AvgScrMath, s.NumTstTakr
FROM schools AS sch
JOIN satscores AS s ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.CDSCode = '1611190130609'
  AND sch.Charter = 1
  AND sch.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sch ON sch.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE sch.County = 'Contra Costa'
  AND s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.NumTstTakr > (
      SELECT NumTstTakr
      FROM satscores
      WHERE cds = '07618040730051'
        AND rtype = 'S'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS qualifying_schools
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sat
  ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.MailCity = 'San Francisco'
  AND s.DOCType IN (
    'Unified School District',
    'High School District',
    'Elementary School District',
    'County Office of Education (COE)'
  )
  AND sat.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
  AND sat.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
  AND sat.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
  AND sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite >= 1500;

SELECT CASE
    WHEN MIN(CASE
        WHEN GSserved LIKE 'P%' THEN -1
        WHEN GSserved LIKE 'TK%' THEN 0
        WHEN GSserved LIKE 'K%' THEN 0
        WHEN GSserved GLOB '[0-9]*-*' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(GSserved, 1, INSTR(GSserved, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER)
    END) = -1 THEN 'P'
    WHEN MIN(CASE
        WHEN GSserved LIKE 'P%' THEN -1
        WHEN GSserved LIKE 'TK%' THEN 0
        WHEN GSserved LIKE 'K%' THEN 0
        WHEN GSserved GLOB '[0-9]*-*' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(GSserved, 1, INSTR(GSserved, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER)
    END) = 0 THEN 'K'
    ELSE CAST(MIN(CASE
        WHEN GSserved LIKE 'P%' THEN -1
        WHEN GSserved LIKE 'TK%' THEN 0
        WHEN GSserved LIKE 'K%' THEN 0
        WHEN GSserved GLOB '[0-9]*-*' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(GSserved, 1, INSTR(GSserved, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER)
    END) AS TEXT)
END AS lowest_grade_level
FROM schools
WHERE NCESDist = '0632640'
  AND GSserved IS NOT NULL;

WITH school_administrators AS (
    SELECT s.CDSCode, s.County, s.District, s.AdmFName1 AS first_name
    FROM schools AS s
    WHERE s.County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND s.SOCType IS NOT NULL
      AND s.AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(s.AdmFName1) <> ''

    UNION

    SELECT s.CDSCode, s.County, s.District, s.AdmFName2 AS first_name
    FROM schools AS s
    WHERE s.County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND s.SOCType IS NOT NULL
      AND s.AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(s.AdmFName2) <> ''

    UNION

    SELECT s.CDSCode, s.County, s.District, s.AdmFName3 AS first_name
    FROM schools AS s
    WHERE s.County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND s.SOCType IS NOT NULL
      AND s.AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(s.AdmFName3) <> ''
),
top_names AS (
    SELECT first_name
    FROM school_administrators
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) DESC, first_name ASC
    LIMIT 2
),
public_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT County, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND SOCType IS NULL
      AND DOCType IN (
          'Unified School District',
          'Elementary School District',
          'High School District',
          'County Office of Education (COE)'
      )
),
district_name_counts AS (
    SELECT sa.County,
           sa.District,
           sa.first_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT sa.CDSCode) AS school_count
    FROM school_administrators AS sa
    JOIN top_names AS t
      ON t.first_name = sa.first_name
    GROUP BY sa.County, sa.District, sa.first_name
)
SELECT d.District AS district_name,
       t.first_name,
       COALESCE(c.school_count, 0) AS school_count
FROM public_districts AS d
CROSS JOIN top_names AS t
LEFT JOIN district_name_counts AS c
  ON c.County = d.County
 AND c.District = d.District
 AND c.first_name = t.first_name
ORDER BY d.District, t.first_name;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)", 0)), 2)
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
 AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
WHERE s.SOCType = 'Youth Authority Facilities';

SELECT s.School, s.AdmEmail1
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
  AND ss.rtype = 'S'
  AND ss.NumGE1500 = (
      SELECT MAX(ss2.NumGE1500)
      FROM schools AS s2
      JOIN satscores AS ss2 ON ss2.cds = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
        AND ss2.rtype = 'S'
  );

WITH middle_schools AS (
    SELECT
        SOCType AS "School Type",
        School AS "School Name",
        Latitude
    FROM schools
    WHERE State = 'CA'
      AND Latitude IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          LOWER(COALESCE(SOCType, '')) LIKE '%middle%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(SOCType, '')) LIKE '%junior high%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(School, '')) LIKE '%middle%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(School, '')) LIKE '%junior high%'
      )
)
SELECT "School Type", "School Name", Latitude
FROM middle_schools
WHERE Latitude = (SELECT MAX(Latitude) FROM middle_schools);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(sa.NumTstTakr, 0)), 2)
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sa
    ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.OpenDate >= '2007-01-01'
  AND s.OpenDate < '2008-01-01'
  AND s.DOCType IN (
      'Elementary School District',
      'High School District',
      'Unified School District',
      'County Office of Education (COE)'
  );

WITH charter_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, FundingType
    FROM schools
    WHERE Charter = 1
      AND StatusType = 'Active'
      AND FundingType IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
),
school_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.FundingType,
        f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
        f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100.0 AS frpm_percentage,
        sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite AS combined_sat
    FROM charter_schools AS s
    LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
        ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
       AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
        ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
)
SELECT
    FundingType,
    COUNT(*) AS school_count,
    SUM(enrollment) AS total_k12_enrollment,
    ROUND(AVG(frpm_percentage), 2) AS average_frpm_eligible_percentage,
    ROUND(AVG(combined_sat), 2) AS average_combined_sat_score
FROM school_metrics
GROUP BY FundingType;

SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    f."Low Grade" AS earliest_grade_level,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    COALESCE(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) AS sat_test_takers
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31'
  AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
ORDER BY
    CASE f."Low Grade"
        WHEN 'P' THEN 0
        WHEN 'K' THEN 1
        ELSE CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) + 1
    END DESC,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC,
    s.School ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
  AND s.School IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.School) <> ''
  AND s.SOC IN ('09', '10', '13', '14', '15', '60', '61', '62', '63', '64', '65', '66', '67', '68', '69')
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500
  AND CAST(f."High Grade" AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
  AND (sat.cds IS NULL OR sat.NumTstTakr = 0);

SELECT
    f."Charter Funding Type" AS "Charter Funding Type",
    COUNT(*) AS "Currently Operating Schools",
    SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS "Total K-12 Enrollment",
    SUM(f."FRPM Count (K-12)") AS "Total FRPM-Eligible K-12 Students"
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
  AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
  AND f."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY f."Charter Funding Type"
ORDER BY CASE f."Charter Funding Type"
    WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2
END;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_sat_schools
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
  ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.State = 'CA'
  AND s.EILName = 'High School'
  AND COALESCE(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) = 0;

WITH school_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM schools
  WHERE County = 'San Diego'
    AND OpenDate >= '1980-01-01'
    AND OpenDate < '1981-01-01'
    AND DOCType IN (
      'Elementary School District',
      'High School District',
      'Unified School District'
    )
)
SELECT CAST(n / 4 AS TEXT) || '/' || CAST(3 AS TEXT) AS average_schools_per_month
FROM school_count;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.Virtual IN ('F', 'P') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS percentage
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
  AND t.AvgScrMath > 400;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        s.School,
        s.GSserved,
        s.Charter,
        1.0 * f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS free_meal_rate
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
      AND s.GSserved LIKE '%12%'
      AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, MAX(free_meal_rate) OVER () AS highest_rate
    FROM eligible
)
SELECT
    r.School AS school_name,
    printf('%.4f', r.free_meal_rate) AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE r.Charter
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN 0 THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS charter_school,
    r.GSserved AS grades_served,
    CASE
        WHEN ss.AvgScrRead IS NULL
          OR ss.AvgScrMath IS NULL
          OR ss.AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS sat_performance_level
FROM ranked AS r
LEFT JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = (
    SELECT s.CDSCode
    FROM schools AS s
    WHERE s.School = r.School
      AND s.County = 'Alameda'
    LIMIT 1
)
WHERE r.free_meal_rate = r.highest_rate;

SELECT
    s.School AS name,
    s.Phone AS phone_number,
    s.Website AS website,
    sat.AvgScrRead AS average_sat_reading,
    sat.AvgScrMath AS average_sat_math,
    sat.AvgScrWrite AS average_sat_writing,
    CASE WHEN s.Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_charter,
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS k12_enrollment_2014_2015,
    ROUND(frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100, 2) AS frpm_eligible_percentage,
    highest.highest_average_sat_math,
    highest.highest_average_sat_math - sat.AvgScrMath AS math_score_below_highest
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN frpm
    ON frpm.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
   AND frpm."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT MAX(sat2.AvgScrMath) AS highest_average_sat_math
    FROM satscores AS sat2
    JOIN schools AS s2
        ON s2.CDSCode = sat2.cds
    WHERE s2.StatusType = 'Active'
      AND sat2.NumTstTakr >= 10
) AS highest
WHERE s.CDSCode = '07618040113118';

WITH virtual_counts AS (
    SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS school_count
    FROM schools
    WHERE Virtual = 'F'
    GROUP BY County
),
top_counties AS (
    SELECT County, school_count
    FROM virtual_counts
    WHERE school_count >= (
        SELECT school_count
        FROM virtual_counts
        ORDER BY school_count DESC
        LIMIT 1 OFFSET 4
    )
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        s.County,
        s.School,
        ss.AvgScrRead,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.County
            ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead DESC
        ) AS score_rank
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
      AND ss.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    t.County,
    t.school_count,
    COALESCE(sc.School, 'None') AS school_name
FROM top_counties AS t
LEFT JOIN scored AS sc
    ON sc.County = t.County
   AND sc.score_rank = 1
ORDER BY t.school_count DESC, t.County, school_name;

WITH counties AS (
    SELECT 'Santa Barbara' AS County
    UNION
    SELECT County
    FROM schools
    WHERE CDSCode = '01100170109835'
)
SELECT c.County, COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS exclusive_virtual_schools
FROM counties AS c
LEFT JOIN schools AS s
    ON s.County = c.County
   AND s.Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY c.County
ORDER BY exclusive_virtual_schools DESC, c.County ASC;

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.School IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.School) <> ''
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30
  AND (
    f."High Grade" = 'K'
    OR (
      f."High Grade" GLOB '[0-9]*'
      AND CAST(f."High Grade" AS INTEGER) <= 8
    )
  );

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) >= 9
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30
ORDER BY s.CDSCode ASC;

SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = (
    SELECT County
    FROM schools
    WHERE substr(CDSCode, 1, 2) = substr('1611430131177', 1, 2)
    LIMIT 1
)
  AND t.rtype = 'S'
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC, s.CDSCode ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.rtype = 'S'
  AND t.NumTstTakr >= 700
  AND t.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1.0 * t.NumGE1500 / t.NumTstTakr ASC,
         CAST(t.cds AS INTEGER) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.Street AS street_address,
    s.City AS city,
    s.State AS state,
    s.Zip AS zip_code
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f."School Type" IN (
      'High Schools (Public)',
      'Continuation High Schools',
      'High Schools In 1 School Dist. (Public)'
  )
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 500
ORDER BY s.School;

SELECT s.County AS county_name,
       SUM(COALESCE(t.NumTstTakr, 0)) AS total_sat_test_takers
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t
  ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
  AND s.Magnet = 1
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Provision 2'
GROUP BY s.County;

WITH counts AS (
    SELECT c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo, COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_count
    FROM cards AS c
    JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
    GROUP BY c.uuid
)
SELECT DISTINCT name, artist, isPromo
FROM counts
WHERE ruling_count = (SELECT MAX(ruling_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY name, artist, isPromo;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fd.language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN c.uuid END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM cards AS c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd
    ON fd.uuid = c.uuid;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.uuid IS NOT NULL THEN c.uuid END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid),
    2
) AS percentage_with_french_translation
FROM cards AS c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS f
    ON f.uuid = c.uuid
   AND f.language = 'French'
WHERE c.isStorySpotlight = 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid)
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.borderColor = 'white'
  AND l.status = 'Banned';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS n
FROM cards AS c
WHERE (c.power IS NULL OR TRIM(c.power) = '' OR c.power LIKE '%*%')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM rulings AS r
      WHERE r.uuid = c.uuid
        AND LOWER(r.text) LIKE '%triggered ability%'
  );

SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN c.uuid END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS percentage
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal';

WITH banned AS (
    SELECT l.format, l.uuid, c.name
    FROM legalities AS l
    JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = l.uuid
    WHERE lower(l.status) = 'banned'
),
counts AS (
    SELECT format, COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS printing_count
    FROM banned
    GROUP BY format
),
top_formats AS (
    SELECT format
    FROM counts
    WHERE printing_count = (SELECT MAX(printing_count) FROM counts)
)
SELECT t.format, group_concat(DISTINCT b.name) AS banned_card_names
FROM top_formats AS t
JOIN banned AS b ON b.format = t.format
GROUP BY t.format
ORDER BY t.format;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name)
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.isPromo = 1
  AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND (
    c.supertypes LIKE '%Legendary%'
    OR c.leadershipSkills LIKE "%brawl': True%"
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM legalities AS l
    WHERE l.uuid = c.uuid
      AND lower(l.format) = 'brawl'
      AND l.status = 'Legal'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT scryfallOracleId)
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'black'
  AND availability LIKE '%mtgo%'
  AND types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) >= 10;

WITH translation_counts AS (
    SELECT setCode, COUNT(DISTINCT translation) AS translation_count
    FROM set_translations
    WHERE translation IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY setCode
)
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(s.totalSetSize, 0)) AS total_cards
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN translation_counts AS tc
    ON tc.setCode = s.code
WHERE COALESCE(tc.translation_count, 0) < 5;

SELECT
    s.type AS set_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN t.translation IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.translation) <> '' THEN s.id
    END) AS translated_set_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN t.translation IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.translation) <> '' THEN c.id
    END) AS card_count
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS t
    ON t.setCode = s.code
LEFT JOIN cards AS c
    ON c.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY s.type
ORDER BY s.type;

WITH named_cards AS (
    SELECT uuid
    FROM cards
    WHERE name = 'Mishra''s Factory'
),
latest AS (
    SELECT MAX(r.date) AS date
    FROM rulings r
    JOIN named_cards c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.text) AS ruling_count
FROM rulings r
JOIN named_cards c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE r.date = (SELECT date FROM latest);

WITH artist_counts AS (
  SELECT artist, COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS creature_card_count
  FROM cards
  WHERE types LIKE '%Creature%'
    AND artist IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(artist) <> ''
    AND name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY artist
)
SELECT artist, creature_card_count
FROM artist_counts
WHERE creature_card_count = (
  SELECT MAX(creature_card_count)
  FROM artist_counts
)
ORDER BY artist;

WITH zero_frame_versions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT frameVersion
    FROM cards
    WHERE convertedManaCost = 0
),
ranked_versions AS (
    SELECT
        frameVersion,
        CASE
            WHEN frameVersion = 'future' THEN 2007
            ELSE CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)
        END AS frame_order
    FROM zero_frame_versions
),
newest_order AS (
    SELECT MAX(frame_order) AS frame_order
    FROM ranked_versions
)
SELECT c.frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN ranked_versions AS r
    ON r.frameVersion = c.frameVersion
JOIN newest_order AS n
    ON n.frame_order = r.frame_order
GROUP BY c.frameVersion
ORDER BY c.frameVersion;

SELECT
  frameVersion AS year,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(*) /
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'),
    2
  ) AS percentage
FROM cards
WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  AND frameVersion = (
    SELECT frameVersion
    FROM cards
    WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
    ORDER BY CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
GROUP BY frameVersion;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.manaCost = '{0}'
  AND LOWER(l.format) = 'commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE ',' || keywords || ',' LIKE '%,Flying,%'
  AND ',' || keywords || ',' LIKE '%,Cycling,%';

WITH abzan_cards AS (
    SELECT name, number, setCode, CAST(number AS INTEGER) AS collector_number
    FROM cards
    WHERE watermark = 'abzan'
),
highest AS (
    SELECT MAX(collector_number) AS collector_number
    FROM abzan_cards
)
SELECT a.name,
       a.number AS collector_number,
       (
           SELECT COUNT(*)
           FROM foreign_data f
           JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = f.uuid
           WHERE c.name = a.name
             AND c.number = a.number
             AND c.setCode = a.setCode
             AND f.language IS NOT NULL
             AND LOWER(f.language) NOT IN ('english', 'en')
       ) AS foreign_language_printings
FROM abzan_cards a
JOIN highest h ON a.collector_number = h.collector_number;

SELECT name
FROM cards
WHERE setCode = 'DKA'
  AND (',' || keywords || ',') LIKE '%,Flash,%'
  AND convertedManaCost = (
      SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost)
      FROM cards
      WHERE setCode = 'DKA'
        AND (',' || keywords || ',') LIKE '%,Flash,%'
  )
ORDER BY name;

SELECT
    s.name,
    s.keyruneCode,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN st.translation IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
        THEN st.language
    END) AS language_count
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
    ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.keyruneCode
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.name;

WITH RECURSIVE qualifying(code) AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.code
    FROM sets AS s
    JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = s.code
    WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2017-01-01'
      AND s.releaseDate < '2018-01-01'
      AND st.language <> 'English'
),
family(code) AS (
    SELECT code FROM qualifying
    UNION
    SELECT child.code
    FROM sets AS child
    JOIN family AS f ON child.parentCode = f.code
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cards
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.setCode IN (SELECT code FROM family);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE duelDeck = 'b'
  AND hasFoil = 0
  AND power IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(power) <> ''
  AND TRIM(power) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.+-]*'
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) < 3;

WITH artist_counts AS (
    SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM cards
    WHERE borderColor = 'black'
      AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
      AND power GLOB '[0-9]*'
      AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10
    GROUP BY artist
)
SELECT artist, card_count
FROM artist_counts
WHERE card_count = (SELECT MAX(card_count) FROM artist_counts);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.hasContentWarning = 1
  AND c.availability LIKE '%paper%'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM cards AS m
    WHERE m.name = c.name
      AND m.availability LIKE '%mtgo%'
  );

SELECT
    s.type AS expansion_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM set_translations st
            WHERE st.setCode = s.code
              AND st.language = 'Japanese'
              AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
              AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
        ) THEN s.id
    END) AS japanese_name_count
FROM sets s
GROUP BY s.type
ORDER BY s.type;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT artist)
FROM cards
WHERE availability LIKE '%arena%'
  AND availability NOT LIKE '%mtgo%'
  AND borderColor = 'black'
  AND types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND power IS NOT NULL
  AND power <> ''
  AND power NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
  AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 5;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards
WHERE setCode = 'UMA'
  AND types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND power IS NOT NULL
  AND toughness IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) > CAST(toughness AS REAL);

SELECT frameVersion AS frame_year, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE leadershipSkills LIKE "%'commander': True%"
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomFoilId != ''
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId != ''
  AND frameVersion = (
    SELECT MAX(frameVersion)
    FROM cards
    WHERE leadershipSkills LIKE "%'commander': True%"
      AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
      AND cardKingdomFoilId != ''
      AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
      AND cardKingdomId != ''
      AND frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*'
  )
GROUP BY frameVersion;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT name
    FROM cards
    WHERE originalType = 'Creature - Elf'
),
card_rulings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.name, r.date, r.text
    FROM eligible AS e
    JOIN cards AS c ON c.name = e.name
    JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
),
counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
    FROM card_rulings
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT name, ruling_count
FROM counts
WHERE ruling_count = (SELECT MAX(ruling_count) FROM counts);

SELECT c.colors AS card_color, COUNT(DISTINCT l.format) AS legal_format_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
GROUP BY c.colors
ORDER BY c.colors;

SELECT frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE artist = 'John Avon'
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId <> ''
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomFoilId <> ''
  AND frameVersion = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER))
      FROM cards
      WHERE artist = 'John Avon'
        AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
        AND cardKingdomId <> ''
        AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
        AND cardKingdomFoilId <> ''
        AND frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*'
  )
GROUP BY frameVersion;

SELECT cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId
FROM cards
WHERE types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomFoilId <> ''
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId <> ''
ORDER BY CAST(cardKingdomFoilId AS INTEGER), name COLLATE NOCASE, CAST(cardKingdomId AS INTEGER)
LIMIT 3;

WITH card_counts AS (
    SELECT c.type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS card_count
    FROM cards AS c
    WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM foreign_data AS f
          WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid
            AND f.language <> 'English'
      )
    GROUP BY c.type
)
SELECT type, card_count
FROM card_counts
WHERE card_count = (SELECT MAX(card_count) FROM card_counts);

WITH guild_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c.watermark AS guild,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS card_count
    FROM cards AS c
    WHERE c.watermark IN (
        'azorius', 'boros', 'dimir', 'golgari', 'gruul',
        'izzet', 'orzhov', 'rakdos', 'selesnya', 'simic'
    )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM foreign_data AS f
          WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid
            AND lower(f.language) <> 'english'
      )
    GROUP BY c.watermark
)
SELECT guild, card_count
FROM guild_counts
WHERE card_count = (SELECT MAX(card_count) FROM guild_counts);

SELECT c.type AS card_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.watermark = 'azorius'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM foreign_data AS f
      WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid
        AND f.language IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(f.language) <> ''
  )
GROUP BY c.type
ORDER BY card_count DESC, card_type ASC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name)
FROM cards
WHERE CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) >= 2015
  AND text IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(text) <> '';

SELECT DISTINCT p.name
FROM cards AS p
WHERE p.isPromo = 1
  AND p.layout IN (
      'split', 'transform', 'adventure', 'aftermath', 'flip',
      'modal_dfc', 'meld', 'double_faced_token', 'reversible_card'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM cards AS c
      WHERE c.scryfallOracleId = p.scryfallOracleId
        AND c.originalReleaseDate >= '2019-01-01'
        AND c.originalReleaseDate < '2020-01-01'
  )
ORDER BY p.name;

SELECT DISTINCT s.name, s.releaseDate
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  AND c.isReprint = 1
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', s.releaseDate) AS INTEGER) - CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER) >= 10
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.name;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT c.setCode, c.number
    FROM cards AS c
    JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE c.name = 'Counterspell'
      AND f.language IN ('French', 'Italian')
    GROUP BY c.setCode, c.number
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.language) = 2
);

SELECT s.name, s.releaseDate
FROM sets AS s
WHERE s.type = (
    SELECT type
    FROM sets
    WHERE name = 'From the Vault: Lore'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations AS st
    WHERE st.setCode = s.code
      AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
)
ORDER BY s.releaseDate ASC;

WITH printings AS (
    SELECT c.frameVersion, s.name AS setName, s.releaseDate
    FROM cards c
    JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
    WHERE c.name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
),
newest_frame AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM printings
    WHERE CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) = (
        SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER))
        FROM printings
    )
)
SELECT DISTINCT setName, releaseDate
FROM newest_frame
WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MAX(releaseDate) FROM newest_frame);

SELECT s.code, s.releaseDate
FROM sets AS s
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM set_translations AS t
      WHERE t.setCode = s.code
        AND t.language = 'Spanish'
        AND t.translation IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(t.translation) <> ''
  )
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.code;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(convertedManaCost), 0)
FROM cards
WHERE artist = 'Rob Alexander'
  AND originalReleaseDate IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(originalReleaseDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 2013;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(language_count), 2) AS average_languages
FROM (
    SELECT s.code,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
               WHEN st.translation IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
               THEN st.language
           END) AS language_count
    FROM sets AS s
    LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = s.code
    WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2016-01-01'
      AND s.releaseDate < '2017-01-01'
    GROUP BY s.code
);

WITH translated_sets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT setCode
    FROM set_translations
    WHERE translation IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(translation) <> ''
)
SELECT
    s.block AS block_name,
    COUNT(ts.setCode) AS sets_with_official_translated_name,
    COALESCE(
        SUM(CASE WHEN ts.setCode IS NOT NULL THEN s.baseSetSize ELSE 0 END),
        0
    ) AS total_base_set_cards
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN translated_sets AS ts
    ON ts.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.block IN ('Masques', 'Mirage')
GROUP BY s.block;

WITH eligible_languages AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT language
    FROM set_translations
    WHERE language IS NOT NULL
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        el.language,
        COUNT(DISTINCT fd.uuid) AS printing_count
    FROM eligible_languages AS el
    LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd
        ON fd.language = el.language
       AND fd.flavorText IS NOT NULL
       AND TRIM(fd.flavorText) <> ''
    GROUP BY el.language
)
SELECT language, printing_count
FROM counts
WHERE printing_count = (SELECT MIN(printing_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY language;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.scryfallOracleId)
FROM cards AS c
JOIN set_translations AS t ON t.setCode = c.setCode
WHERE t.language = 'French'
  AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND CAST(c.power AS REAL) >= 10;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(convertedManaCost), 1)
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.scryfallOracleId, c.convertedManaCost
    FROM cards AS c
    WHERE c.edhrecRank BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
      AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
      AND c.scryfallOracleId IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM legalities AS l
          WHERE l.uuid = c.uuid
            AND l.status = 'Banned'
      )
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.originalReleaseDate >= '2014-01-01'
  AND c.originalReleaseDate < '2015-01-01'
  AND s.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.mtgoCode) <> '';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid)
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND f.language = 'Italian'
  AND f.text IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(f.text) <> '';

WITH candidate_sets AS (
    SELECT id, code, name
    FROM sets
    WHERE type = 'commander'
      AND releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
      AND releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
),
card_counts AS (
    SELECT cs.id, cs.code, cs.name, COUNT(c.id) AS total_card_count
    FROM candidate_sets AS cs
    LEFT JOIN sets AS related
      ON related.code = cs.code
      OR related.parentCode = cs.code
    LEFT JOIN cards AS c
      ON c.setCode = related.code
     AND c.isOnlineOnly = 0
    GROUP BY cs.id, cs.code, cs.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_card_count DESC) AS count_rank
    FROM card_counts
)
SELECT r.id,
       r.name,
       (
           SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fd.language) + 1
           FROM cards AS c
           JOIN foreign_data AS fd
             ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
           WHERE c.setCode = r.code
             AND c.isOnlineOnly = 0
       ) AS official_language_count
FROM ranked AS r
WHERE r.count_rank = 1
ORDER BY r.id ASC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fd.language) AS language_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Swamp';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
WHERE p.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation';

SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
    - 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
    AS difference_percentage_points
FROM badges
WHERE Name = 'Student'
  AND Date IS NOT NULL;

SELECT p.Id, u.DisplayName
FROM posts AS p
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
ORDER BY p.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.ViewCount,
       COALESCE(u.DisplayName, p.LastEditorDisplayName) AS LastEditorDisplayName
FROM posts AS p
LEFT JOIN users AS u
    ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Computer game datasets';

SELECT c.Text, COALESCE(u.DisplayName, c.UserDisplayName) AS DisplayName
FROM comments AS c
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = c.PostId
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE p.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c.CreationDate DESC, c.Id DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_zero_score_comments
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE c.Score = 0
  AND c.PostId IN (
    SELECT PostId
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY PostId
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
  );

SELECT SUM(u.Reputation) AS total_reputation
FROM users u
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%United Kingdom%'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM posts p
      WHERE p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Age), 2) AS average_age
FROM users AS u
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.UserId
    FROM comments AS c
    WHERE c.Text LIKE '%http://%'
      AND c.UserId IS NOT NULL
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id) AS count
FROM users u
WHERE (u.Location LIKE '%Germany%' OR u.Location LIKE '%Munich%')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM badges organizer
    WHERE organizer.UserId = u.Id
      AND organizer.Name = 'Organizer'
      AND (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM badges prior
        WHERE prior.UserId = organizer.UserId
          AND prior.Date < organizer.Date
      ) >= 5
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM users AS u
WHERE (TRIM(u.Location) = 'India' OR TRIM(u.Location) LIKE '%, India')
  AND u.Id IN (
    SELECT p.OwnerUserId
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.OwnerUserId
    HAVING MIN(p.CreaionDate) >= '2010-01-01'
       AND MIN(p.CreaionDate) < '2011-01-01'
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(Reputation)) AS average_reputation
FROM users
WHERE Id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT OwnerUserId
    FROM posts
    WHERE Score < 20
      AND Tags LIKE '%<r>%'
      AND OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
);

SELECT SUM(u.Reputation) AS combined_reputation
FROM users u
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.OwnerUserId
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.Score = 10
      AND p.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM tags t
          WHERE t.TagName = 'r'
            AND instr(p.Tags, '<' || t.TagName || '>') > 0
      )
);

SELECT SUM(u.Reputation) AS combined_reputation
FROM users AS u
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.OwnerUserId
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.LasActivityDate >= '2014-08-27'
      AND p.LasActivityDate < '2014-08-28'
      AND p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%'
);

WITH user_badge_totals AS (
    SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName, COUNT(b.Id) AS badge_total
    FROM users AS u
    LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
    GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
),
second_total AS (
    SELECT MAX(badge_total) AS badge_total
    FROM user_badge_totals
    WHERE badge_total < (SELECT MAX(badge_total) FROM user_badge_totals)
)
SELECT ubt.DisplayName, ubt.badge_total
FROM user_badge_totals AS ubt
JOIN second_total AS st ON ubt.badge_total = st.badge_total
ORDER BY ubt.DisplayName;

SELECT Age
FROM users
WHERE Location IN ('York', 'York, United Kingdom')
  AND Reputation = (
    SELECT MAX(Reputation)
    FROM users
    WHERE Location IN ('York', 'York, United Kingdom')
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.UserId) AS user_count
FROM badges AS b
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE b.Name = 'Yearling'
  AND b.Date < '2014-01-01'
  AND (TRIM(u.Location) = 'India' OR TRIM(u.Location) LIKE '%, India');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.DisplayName) AS distinct_display_names
FROM users AS u
JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE b.Name = 'Supporter'
  AND u.Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65
  AND u.DisplayName <> 'NaN';

SELECT Id
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName = 'Michael'
ORDER BY CreationDate DESC, Id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
           WHEN p.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL THEN 'u:' || p.OwnerUserId
           ELSE 'n:' || p.OwnerDisplayName
       END) AS user_count
FROM votes AS v
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = v.PostId
WHERE v.VoteTypeId = 8
  AND v.BountyAmount >= 30
  AND v.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND v.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
  AND (p.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL OR p.OwnerDisplayName IS NOT NULL);

WITH prolific_users AS (
    SELECT OwnerUserId AS user_id
    FROM posts
    WHERE CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
      AND OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY OwnerUserId
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(u.UpVotes), 2) AS average_upvotes_cast,
    ROUND(AVG(u.Age), 2) AS average_age
FROM prolific_users p
JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.user_id;

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
    VALUES ('2010-01-01')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
    FROM months
    WHERE month_start < '2010-12-01'
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT
        m.month_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pl.RelatedPostId) AS post_count
    FROM months AS m
    LEFT JOIN postLinks AS pl
        ON pl.CreationDate >= m.month_start
       AND pl.CreationDate < date(m.month_start, '+1 month')
       AND pl.RelatedPostId IN (
           SELECT Id
           FROM posts
           WHERE AnswerCount <= 2
       )
    GROUP BY m.month_start
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(post_count), 2) AS average_posts
FROM monthly;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.Id IS NULL OR u.Reputation < 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM posts AS p
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
  AND p.Score > 5;

WITH editor_counts AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(u.DisplayName, ph.UserDisplayName) AS editor_display_name,
        COUNT(*) AS edit_comment_count
    FROM postHistory AS ph
    JOIN posts AS p
        ON p.Id = ph.PostId
    LEFT JOIN users AS u
        ON u.Id = ph.UserId
    WHERE p.Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
      AND ph.PostHistoryTypeId IN (4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9)
      AND ph.Comment IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(ph.Comment) <> ''
    GROUP BY ph.UserId, COALESCE(u.DisplayName, ph.UserDisplayName)
)
SELECT editor_display_name, edit_comment_count
FROM editor_counts
WHERE edit_comment_count = (SELECT MAX(edit_comment_count) FROM editor_counts);

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
rates AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2012 AS increase_pct
    FROM yearly
)
SELECT
    Segment,
    ROUND(increase_pct, 2) AS increase_percentage
FROM rates
WHERE increase_pct = (SELECT MAX(increase_pct) FROM rates)
   OR increase_pct = (SELECT MIN(increase_pct) FROM rates)
ORDER BY increase_pct DESC;

SELECT ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END))
    / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END),
    4
) AS relative_change
FROM yearmonth AS ym
WHERE ym.CustomerID = (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM "transactions_1k"
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
)
AND substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS count_customers
FROM customers AS c
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM yearmonth AS y12
    WHERE y12.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
      AND y12.Date >= '201201'
      AND y12.Date < '201301'
      AND y12.Consumption > 0
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM yearmonth AS y13
    WHERE y13.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
      AND y13.Date >= '201301'
      AND y13.Date < '201401'
      AND y13.Consumption > 0
  );

SELECT c.Segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers AS c
JOIN (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING SUM(Consumption) < 30000
) AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment;

SELECT c.Segment, COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID) AS customer_count
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN yearmonth AS y
  ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
 AND y.Date >= '201301'
 AND y.Date < '201401'
 AND y.Consumption IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.Segment;

SELECT
    (
        CAST(strftime('%s', MAX(t.Date || ' ' || t.Time)) AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%s', MIN(t.Date || ' ' || t.Time)) AS INTEGER)
    ) / 60 AS whole_minutes
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN gasstations AS gs
    ON gs.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE gs.Country = 'CZE'
  AND t.Price > 1000
  AND t.ProductID IN (
      SELECT ProductID
      FROM products
      WHERE Description IN (
          'Nafta', 'Special', 'Super', 'Natural', 'Mix',
          'Natural +', 'Diesel +', 'Natural Plus', 'Nafta Plus'
      )
  );

WITH active_customers AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201311'
      AND Consumption <> 0
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Date) = 11
)
SELECT c.Currency, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM active_customers AS a
JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Currency;

WITH quarterly AS (
    SELECT
        y.CustomerID,
        c.Currency,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS quarter_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date IN ('201304', '201305', '201306')
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Currency
)
SELECT
    Currency,
    ROUND(AVG(quarter_consumption), 2) AS average_quarter_consumption
FROM quarterly
WHERE Currency IN ('EUR', 'CZK')
GROUP BY Currency;

WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT
        substr(Date, 1, 4) AS year,
        Date,
        SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE substr(Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY Date
),
yearly_peaks AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        MAX(total_consumption) AS peak_consumption
    FROM monthly_totals
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT ROUND(
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN peak_consumption END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN peak_consumption END)
) AS difference
FROM yearly_peaks;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date >= '201301'
      AND ym.Date < '201401'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
    HAVING SUM(ym.Consumption) > 1000000
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND y.Date = '201302'
  AND y.Consumption > 0;

WITH away_wins AS (
    SELECT t.team_long_name AS away_team, COUNT(*) AS win_count
    FROM "Match" AS m
    JOIN League AS l ON l.id = m.league_id
    JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
    WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
      AND m.season = '2009/2010'
      AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
    GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name
)
SELECT away_team
FROM away_wins
WHERE win_count = (SELECT MAX(win_count) FROM away_wins)
ORDER BY away_team;

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
JOIN Team AS t
  ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE ta.date >= '2012-01-01'
  AND ta.date < '2013-01-01'
  AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes
      WHERE date >= '2012-01-01'
        AND date < '2013-01-01'
  );

SELECT p.player_api_id, p.player_name, AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) AS mean_heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY mean_heading_accuracy DESC, p.player_api_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT l.name
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
HAVING AVG(m.home_team_goal) > AVG(m.away_team_goal)
ORDER BY l.name;

WITH named AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, player_name
    FROM Player
    WHERE player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        n.player_name,
        a.overall_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY n.player_api_id
            ORDER BY a.date DESC, a.id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM named n
    JOIN Player_Attributes a
        ON a.player_api_id = n.player_api_id
),
latest AS (
    SELECT player_name, overall_rating
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * (
        MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN overall_rating END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN overall_rating END)
    ) / MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN overall_rating END),
    2
) AS percentage_higher
FROM latest;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Player_Attributes pa
        WHERE pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
          AND pa.overall_rating > 70
    ) THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM Player p
WHERE p.height < 180;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(height), 2) AS avg_height_cm
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
  AND player_api_id IN (
    SELECT home_player_3
    FROM "Match"
    WHERE home_player_3 IS NOT NULL
  );

WITH eligible_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.player_api_id
    FROM Player AS p
    JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
      ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.birthday >= '1991-01-01'
      AND pa.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
),
high_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.player_api_id
    FROM Player AS p
    JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
      ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.birthday >= '1991-01-01'
      AND pa.defensive_work_rate = 'high'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(hp.player_api_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(ep.player_api_id), 0),
    2
)
FROM eligible_players AS ep
LEFT JOIN high_players AS hp
  ON hp.player_api_id = ep.player_api_id;

WITH ranked_attributes AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        overall_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE date <= '2010-12-31'
),
qualified_players AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM ranked_attributes
    WHERE rn = 1
      AND overall_rating > 80
),
player_appearances AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, COUNT(*) AS match_count
    FROM (
        SELECT id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_2 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_3 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_4 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_5 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_6 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_7 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_8 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_9 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_10 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_11 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_1 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_2 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_3 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_4 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_5 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_6 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_7 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_8 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_9 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_10 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_11 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2010/2011'
    )
    WHERE player_api_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pa.match_count, 0)), 2) AS average_matches
FROM qualified_players qp
LEFT JOIN player_appearances pa USING (player_api_id);

WITH ranked_attributes AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        defensive_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2)
FROM Player AS p
JOIN ranked_attributes AS ra
    ON ra.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE ra.rn = 1
  AND ra.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'high');

WITH risky_teams AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT team_api_id
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky'
),
latest AS (
    SELECT
        team_api_id,
        chanceCreationPassing,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY team_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE date < '2014-09-20'
)
SELECT
    t.team_short_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS club_count,
    ROUND(AVG(l.chanceCreationPassing), 1) AS avg_chance_creation_passing_risk
FROM risky_teams r
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
JOIN latest l ON l.team_api_id = r.team_api_id AND l.rn = 1
GROUP BY t.team_short_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) > 1
ORDER BY avg_chance_creation_passing_risk DESC, t.team_short_name ASC;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        defensive_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(defensive_work_rate)) IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM Player AS p
JOIN ranked AS r
    ON r.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
   AND r.rn = 1
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1995'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(r.defensive_work_rate)) = 'medium';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.weight), 1) AS average_weight
FROM Player p
WHERE p.player_api_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT pa.player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left'
);

WITH lineup AS (
    SELECT m.id AS match_id, m.home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.home_player_2 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.home_player_3 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.home_player_4 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.home_player_5 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.home_player_6 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.home_player_7 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.home_player_8 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.home_player_9 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.home_player_10 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.home_player_11 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.away_player_1 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.away_player_2 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.away_player_3 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.away_player_4 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.away_player_5 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.away_player_6 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.away_player_7 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.away_player_8 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.away_player_9 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.away_player_10 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.away_player_11 FROM "Match" m WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
)
SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.match_id) AS number_of_matches
FROM Player p
LEFT JOIN lineup l ON l.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name LIKE 'Adam%'
  AND p.weight > 170
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name;

SELECT ta.buildUpPlayDribblingClass
FROM Team AS t
JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_short_name = 'POR'
  AND t.team_long_name = 'Portsmouth'
  AND ta.date >= '2015-09-10'
  AND ta.date < '2015-09-11';

WITH qualifying_home_wins AS (
    SELECT m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id
    FROM "Match" AS m
    WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
          WHERE ta.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
            AND ta.date <= m.date
            AND ta.id = (
                SELECT ta2.id
                FROM Team_Attributes AS ta2
                WHERE ta2.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
                  AND ta2.date <= m.date
                ORDER BY ta2.date DESC, ta2.id DESC
                LIMIT 1
            )
            AND ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
      )
)
SELECT
    t.team_long_name AS club_name,
    t.team_short_name AS short_name,
    COUNT(*) AS home_wins
FROM qualifying_home_wins AS q
JOIN Team AS t
    ON t.team_api_id = q.team_api_id
GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name
ORDER BY home_wins DESC, club_name, t.team_api_id;

WITH heavy_losses AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM "Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal - away_team_goal >= 5
),
away_lineup AS (
    SELECT season, away_player_1 AS player_id FROM heavy_losses
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_2 FROM heavy_losses
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_3 FROM heavy_losses
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_4 FROM heavy_losses
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_5 FROM heavy_losses
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_6 FROM heavy_losses
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_7 FROM heavy_losses
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_8 FROM heavy_losses
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_9 FROM heavy_losses
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_10 FROM heavy_losses
    UNION ALL SELECT season, away_player_11 FROM heavy_losses
)
SELECT season, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS different_players
FROM away_lineup
WHERE player_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY season
ORDER BY season;

WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_id FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM "Match"
),
counts AS (
    SELECT c.name AS country_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM appearances a
    JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = a.player_id
    JOIN Country c ON c.id = a.country_id
    WHERE a.player_id IS NOT NULL
      AND p.weight >= 210
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name
)
SELECT country_name, player_count
FROM counts
WHERE player_count = (SELECT MAX(player_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY country_name;

WITH season_players AS (
    SELECT m.season, p.player_api_id, p.height
    FROM "Match" AS m
    JOIN League AS l ON l.id = m.league_id
    JOIN Country AS c ON c.id = l.country_id
    JOIN Player AS p
      ON p.player_api_id IN (
          m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3,
          m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6,
          m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9,
          m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
          m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3,
          m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6,
          m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9,
          m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
      )
    WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
      AND m.season IN ('2008/2009', '2015/2016')
),
distinct_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT season, player_api_id, height
    FROM season_players
)
SELECT season,
       COUNT(*) AS player_count,
       ROUND(AVG(height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM distinct_players
GROUP BY season
ORDER BY season;

WITH player_totals AS (
  SELECT p.player_api_id, COALESCE(SUM(m.home_team_goal), 0) AS total_home_goals
  FROM Player AS p
  LEFT JOIN "Match" AS m
    ON m.home_player_3 = p.player_api_id
  GROUP BY p.player_api_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_home_goals), 2) AS average_total_home_goals
FROM player_totals;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        preferred_foot,
        attacking_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE date <= '2015-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
  AND preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium');

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        preferred_foot,
        attacking_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT attacking_work_rate
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
      AND LOWER(TRIM(preferred_foot)) = 'left'
      AND LOWER(TRIM(attacking_work_rate)) IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(attacking_work_rate)) = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / COUNT(*),
    1
) AS percentage
FROM eligible;

WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT id, home_player_1 AS player_id FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_2 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_3 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_4 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_5 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_6 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_7 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_8 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_9 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_10 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_11 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_1 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_2 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_3 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_4 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_5 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_6 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_7 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_8 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_9 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_10 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_11 FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016'
)
SELECT
    p.player_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS matches_played
FROM Player AS p
LEFT JOIN appearances AS a
    ON a.player_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
  AND p.birthday > '1990-12-31'
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY p.player_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS count_players
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE date >= '2007-02-22'
  AND date < '2007-08-31'
  AND jumping >= 80;

SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team AS t
JOIN Match AS m
  ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
  OR m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta
  ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
 AND ta.date = (
     SELECT MAX(ta2.date)
     FROM Team_Attributes AS ta2
     WHERE ta2.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
       AND ta2.date <= m.date
 )
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
  AND m.season = '2012/2013'
ORDER BY m.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH salary_range AS (
    SELECT MIN(A11) AS lowest_salary,
           MAX(A11) AS highest_salary
    FROM district
),
lowest_salary_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A11 = (SELECT lowest_salary FROM salary_range)
),
female_clients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date
    FROM client AS c
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM lowest_salary_districts)
),
oldest_female_clients AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM female_clients
    WHERE birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM female_clients)
)
SELECT DISTINCT dp.account_id,
       sr.highest_salary - sr.lowest_salary AS salary_difference
FROM oldest_female_clients AS ofc
JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = ofc.client_id
CROSS JOIN salary_range AS sr
ORDER BY dp.account_id;

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2 AS district
FROM client c
JOIN disp p ON p.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = p.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT ROUND(
           100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
           2
       )
FROM client AS c
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE d.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT
  (MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1998-12-27' THEN t.balance END) -
   MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1993-03-22' THEN t.balance END)) * 100.0 /
  MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1993-03-22' THEN t.balance END) AS percentage_increase
FROM loan AS l
JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
  AND t.date IN ('1993-03-22', '1998-12-27');

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE a.date >= '1995-01-01'
  AND a.date < '2001-01-01'
  AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.A2 AS district,
    ROUND((d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / d.A12, 2) AS percentage_change
FROM district AS d
JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'
  AND d.A12 IS NOT NULL
  AND d.A13 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.A2;

SELECT d.type, COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS account_count
FROM disp AS d
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district AS dist ON dist.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND dist.A11 > 8000
  AND dist.A11 <= 9000
GROUP BY d.type;

WITH annual AS (
    SELECT
        substr(l.date, 1, 4) AS year,
        SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN disp AS d
        ON d.account_id = l.account_id
       AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c
        ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
      AND substr(l.date, 1, 4) IN ('1996', '1997')
    GROUP BY substr(l.date, 1, 4)
)
SELECT
    100.0 * (
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = '1997' THEN total_amount END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN year = '1996' THEN total_amount END)
    ) / MAX(CASE WHEN year = '1996' THEN total_amount END) AS percentage_growth
FROM annual;

SELECT a.frequency, o.k_symbol
FROM account AS a
JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = 3
  AND o.amount = 3539;

WITH first_month AS (
    SELECT MIN(date) AS first_date
    FROM account
),
opened_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM account AS a
    CROSS JOIN first_month AS f
    WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', a.date) = strftime('%Y-%m', f.first_date)
),
qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT d.A2 AS district, CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population
    FROM opened_districts AS o
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = o.district_id
)
SELECT district, population
FROM qualifying_districts
WHERE population = (SELECT MAX(population) FROM qualifying_districts);

WITH top_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id, A2 AS district_name
    FROM district
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
district_averages AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.district_name,
        1.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
            / COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS avg_active_loan
    FROM top_districts d
    JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.district_name
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    ROUND(avg_active_loan) AS average_active_loan_per_account
FROM district_averages
ORDER BY avg_active_loan DESC;

WITH region_totals AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE date(l.date) <= '1995-12-31'
      AND date(l.date, '+' || l.duration || ' months') > '1995-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.A3
)
SELECT region, total_amount
FROM region_totals
WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM region_totals);

WITH older_owner_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(l.loan_count, 0)), 2) AS average_loans_per_account
FROM older_owner_accounts AS a
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
) AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id;

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
counterparties AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS counterparty_count
    FROM trans
    WHERE bank IS NOT NULL
      AND account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY account_id
),
households AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS opening_date,
        lt.total_amount_borrowed,
        COALESCE(cp.counterparty_count, 0) AS counterparty_count,
        owner_client.district_id AS home_district_id,
        CAST(home_district.A4 AS INTEGER) AS district_population
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN loan_totals AS lt ON lt.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district AS branch_district ON branch_district.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN disp AS owner_disp
      ON owner_disp.account_id = a.account_id
     AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS owner_client ON owner_client.client_id = owner_disp.client_id
    JOIN district AS home_district ON home_district.district_id = owner_client.district_id
    LEFT JOIN counterparties AS cp ON cp.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE branch_district.A2 = 'Prachatice'
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    opening_date,
    total_amount_borrowed,
    counterparty_count,
    home_district_id,
    district_population,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY district_population DESC) AS population_rank
FROM households
ORDER BY population_rank, account_id;

WITH avg_bal AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.gender, a.district_id
    FROM card cd
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    JOIN avg_bal ab ON ab.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
      AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
      AND ab.avg_balance > 1000
      AND CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) > 100000
),
agg AS (
    SELECT ed.gender,
           COUNT(*) AS district_count,
           MAX(CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER)) AS max_inhabitants,
           ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS avg_salary,
           ROUND(AVG(d.A13), 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
    FROM eligible_districts ed
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = ed.district_id
    GROUP BY ed.gender
)
SELECT agg.gender,
       agg.district_count,
       d.A2 AS district,
       CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
       agg.avg_salary,
       agg.avg_urban_ratio
FROM agg
JOIN eligible_districts ed ON ed.gender = agg.gender
JOIN district d
  ON d.district_id = ed.district_id
 AND CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) = agg.max_inhabitants
ORDER BY CASE agg.gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
         d.A2;

WITH eligible_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN card AS c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN district AS di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.type = 'gold'
      AND CAST(di.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 250000
),
pair_totals AS (
    SELECT
        t.bank,
        t.account,
        COUNT(*) AS outgoing_payments,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN eligible_accounts AS ea ON ea.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
      AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
      AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
)
SELECT bank, account, outgoing_payments, total_amount
FROM pair_totals
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.amount),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek'
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> '';

WITH eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN disp AS own
      ON own.client_id = c.client_id
     AND own.type = 'OWNER'
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM card AS ca
          WHERE ca.disp_id = own.disp_id
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM loan AS l
          WHERE l.account_id = own.account_id
      )
),
region_districts AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
        d.A11 AS salary,
        d.A13 AS unemployment
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN eligible_districts AS e
      ON e.district_id = d.district_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY region
            ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM region_districts
)
SELECT
    region,
    ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS average_district_salary,
    ROUND(AVG(unemployment), 2) AS average_1996_unemployment_rate,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN district_name END) AS most_populous_district
FROM ranked
GROUP BY region;

WITH central_districts AS (
    SELECT
        A2 AS district_name,
        CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
        A16 AS crimes_1996,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC,
                LOWER(A2) COLLATE NOCASE,
                A2 COLLATE NOCASE
        ) AS population_rank
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'central Bohemia'
),
top_three AS (
    SELECT district_name, inhabitants, crimes_1996
    FROM central_districts
    WHERE population_rank <= 3
),
averages AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT AVG(crimes_1996) FROM top_three) AS three_district_average,
        (SELECT AVG(A16) FROM district) AS overall_average
)
SELECT
    t.district_name,
    t.inhabitants,
    t.crimes_1996,
