    ROUND(a.three_district_average, 2) AS three_district_average,
    ROUND(a.overall_average, 2) AS overall_average,
    ROUND(a.three_district_average - a.overall_average, 2) AS average_difference
FROM top_three AS t
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
ORDER BY
    t.inhabitants DESC,
    LOWER(t.district_name) COLLATE NOCASE,
    t.district_name COLLATE NOCASE;

WITH region_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, d.A2 AS district_name
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.A3 = (
        SELECT A3
        FROM district
        WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice'
    )
      AND a.date >= '1996-01-01'
      AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
),
ranked_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        t.balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY t.account_id
            ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN region_accounts AS ra ON ra.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.date < '1997-01-01'
),
account_balances AS (
    SELECT
        ra.account_id,
        ra.district_name,
        rt.balance
    FROM region_accounts AS ra
    LEFT JOIN ranked_transactions AS rt
        ON rt.account_id = ra.account_id
       AND rt.rn = 1
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT
        district_name,
        COUNT(*) AS account_count,
        AVG(balance) AS raw_average_balance,
        ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS average_balance
    FROM account_balances
    GROUP BY district_name
),
region_average AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS region_average_balance
    FROM account_balances
),
highest_district AS (
    SELECT district_name
    FROM district_stats
    ORDER BY raw_average_balance DESC, district_name
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    ds.district_name,
    ds.account_count,
    ds.average_balance,
    ra.region_average_balance,
    hd.district_name AS highest_average_balance_district
FROM district_stats AS ds
CROSS JOIN region_average AS ra
CROSS JOIN highest_district AS hd
ORDER BY ds.district_name;

WITH top_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a
      ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
    ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.loan_id ASC
    LIMIT 10
),
loan_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM top_loans AS t
    JOIN account AS a
      ON a.account_id = t.account_id
),
district_metrics AS (
    SELECT d.district_id,
           CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
           d.A11 AS average_salary
    FROM loan_districts AS ld
    JOIN district AS d
      ON d.district_id = ld.district_id
)
SELECT district_id,
       inhabitants,
       ROUND((SELECT AVG(average_salary) FROM district_metrics), 2) AS average_salary
FROM district_metrics
ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH
account_access AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 3541
),
transaction_summary AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
regional_client_counts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        A3 AS region,
        A2 AS district_name,
        CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY A3
            ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
        ) AS population_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(A2) OVER (
            PARTITION BY A3
            ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS most_populous_district,
        FIRST_VALUE(CAST(A4 AS INTEGER)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY A3
            ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS most_populous_inhabitants
    FROM district
)
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.date AS date_opened,
    a.frequency,
    ad.A2 AS district_name,
    ad.A3 AS region,
    CASE WHEN ad.district_id = home.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
    ad.A11 AS average_salary,
    COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_repayment_status,
    COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
    COALESCE(ts.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance,
    rcc.client_count AS clients_in_region,
    rd.most_populous_district,
    rd.most_populous_inhabitants,
    rd.population_rank AS account_district_population_rank
FROM account_access aa
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = aa.account_id
JOIN district ad ON ad.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN client home ON home.client_id = 3541
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN transaction_summary ts ON ts.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN regional_client_counts rcc ON rcc.region = ad.A3
JOIN ranked_districts rd ON rd.district_id = ad.district_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, a.account_id ASC;

WITH account_lending AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id,
        strftime('%Y', a.date) AS opening_year,
        COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS amount_lent
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE d.A3 = 'central Bohemia'
      AND a.date >= '1996-01-01'
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, strftime('%Y', a.date)
),
district_year AS (
    SELECT
        opening_year,
        district_id,
        SUM(amount_lent) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS amount_per_account
    FROM account_lending
    GROUP BY opening_year, district_id
),
year_summary AS (
    SELECT
        opening_year,
        COUNT(*) AS account_count,
        SUM(amount_lent) AS total_amount_lent
    FROM account_lending
    GROUP BY opening_year
)
SELECT
    ys.opening_year,
    ys.account_count,
    ys.total_amount_lent,
    ROUND(AVG(dy.amount_per_account), 2) AS average_district_amount_per_account
FROM year_summary AS ys
JOIN district_year AS dy ON dy.opening_year = ys.opening_year
GROUP BY ys.opening_year
ORDER BY ys.opening_year;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.date AS approval_date,
        l.amount AS approved_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.date ASC, l.loan_id
        ) AS loan_rank
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
selected_loans AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked_loans
    WHERE loan_rank <= 10
),
ranked_balances AS (
    SELECT
        sl.loan_id,
        t.balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY sl.loan_id
            ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
        ) AS balance_rank
    FROM selected_loans AS sl
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = sl.account_id
       AND t.date <= sl.approval_date
)
SELECT
    d.A2 AS district,
    sl.approved_amount,
    sl.approval_date,
    rb.balance AS account_balance
FROM selected_loans AS sl
JOIN account AS a
    ON a.account_id = sl.account_id
JOIN district AS d
    ON d.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN ranked_balances AS rb
    ON rb.loan_id = sl.loan_id
   AND rb.balance_rank = 1
ORDER BY sl.approved_amount DESC, sl.approval_date ASC, sl.loan_id;

WITH card_clients AS (
    SELECT
        c.client_id,
        c.gender,
        c.birth_date,
        card.type AS card_type,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', card.issued) AS INTEGER)
            - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_issue,
        c.district_id,
        disp.account_id
    FROM card
    JOIN disp ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
    WHERE card.issued >= '1994-01-01'
      AND card.issued < '1995-01-01'
),
account_loan_totals AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
        SUM(amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    cc.client_id,
    cc.gender,
    cc.birth_date,
    cc.card_type,
    cc.age_at_issue,
    COALESCE(lt.loan_count, 0) AS number_of_loans,
    COALESCE(lt.total_borrowed, 0) AS total_amount_borrowed,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(lt.loan_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'Non-borrower'
        WHEN cc.age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
        ELSE 'Mature borrower'
    END AS borrower_classification,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A11 AS district_average_salary,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY cc.gender
        ORDER BY cc.age_at_issue
    ) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM card_clients cc
LEFT JOIN account_loan_totals lt ON lt.account_id = cc.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = cc.district_id
ORDER BY cc.client_id;

SELECT d.A2 AS branch, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count
FROM district AS d
JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'north Moravia'
  AND t.date <= '1998-10-14'
  AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR trim(t.k_symbol) = '')
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    t.bank AS bank_code,
    t.account AS account_number,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_outgoing_payments,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_paid
FROM trans AS t
WHERE t.account_id = (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan AS l
    WHERE l.amount = 98832
      AND l.date = '1996-01-03'
)
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date < '1996-01-03'
  AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
  AND t.account IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l
  ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE
    WHEN t.k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN t.amount
    WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -t.amount
    ELSE 0
END), 0) AS net_interest_czk
FROM disp AS d
JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 2823
  AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
  AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
  AND t.k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK');

WITH female_loans AS (
    SELECT l.*, d.client_id
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN disp AS d
      ON d.account_id = l.account_id
     AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c
      ON c.client_id = d.client_id
     AND c.gender = 'F'
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT *,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS amount_rank
    FROM female_loans
),
account_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
region_loan_counts AS (
    SELECT branch.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS loans_granted
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS branch ON branch.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY branch.A3
),
region_salaries AS (
    SELECT A3 AS region, AVG(A11) AS avg_district_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY A3
)
SELECT
    r.client_id,
    r.amount AS loan_amount,
    r.duration AS duration_months,
    ROUND(r.payments * r.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND(r.payments * r.duration - r.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
    r.status AS loan_status,
    branch.A2 AS branch_district,
    branch.A3 AS branch_region,
    COALESCE(t.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(t.total_deposits, 0), 2) AS total_deposits,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(t.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * r.amount THEN 'High Income'
        WHEN COALESCE(t.total_deposits, 0) > r.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
        ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category,
    rc.loans_granted AS region_loan_count,
    ROUND(rs.avg_district_salary, 2) AS region_avg_salary,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      - CASE
            WHEN strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) > '10-09' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS age
FROM ranked_loans AS r
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = r.client_id
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = r.account_id
JOIN district AS branch ON branch.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN account_transactions AS t ON t.account_id = r.account_id
JOIN region_loan_counts AS rc ON rc.region = branch.A3
JOIN region_salaries AS rs ON rs.region = branch.A3
WHERE r.amount_rank <= 3
ORDER BY r.amount DESC, r.client_id;

WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.duration > 24
      AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
),
district_q AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district,
        d.A3 AS region,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population,
        COUNT(DISTINCT q.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4
),
region_q AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        GROUP_CONCAT(district, ', ') AS districts,
        COUNT(*) AS district_count,
        SUM(population) AS combined_population,
        SUM(account_count) AS account_count
    FROM district_q
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    region,
    districts,
    district_count,
    combined_population,
    account_count,
    CASE
        WHEN region = (
            SELECT region
            FROM region_q
            ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region ASC
            LIMIT 1
        ) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_largest_population_region
FROM region_q
ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region ASC;

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A11 AS salary,
        COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 100000
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'
      AND a.date < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A11
)
SELECT
    SUM(account_count) AS total_accounts,
    COUNT(*) AS district_count,
    ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS average_salary
FROM qualifying_districts;

WITH
branch_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
      AND a.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
owner_profile AS (
    SELECT ba.account_id, ba.opened_date, c.gender, c.birth_date
    FROM branch_accounts ba
    JOIN disp dp
      ON dp.account_id = ba.account_id
     AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
),
card_counts AS (
    SELECT dp.account_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM disp dp
    JOIN card ca ON ca.disp_id = dp.disp_id
    WHERE ca.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY dp.account_id
),
loan_summary AS (
    SELECT l.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
           CASE
               WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
                   THEN 'defaulted'
               WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
                   THEN 'repaying'
               ELSE 'paid off'
           END AS standing
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
activity AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
           MAX(t.balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date >= '1997-01-01'
      AND t.date < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
profile AS (
    SELECT op.account_id,
           op.opened_date,
           op.gender,
           CAST(strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') AS INTEGER)
             - CAST(strftime('%Y', op.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
             - CASE
                   WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '1996-12-31') < strftime('%m-%d', op.birth_date)
                   THEN 1 ELSE 0
               END AS owner_age,
           COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
           COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
           COALESCE(ls.standing, 'no loan') AS loan_standing,
           COALESCE(ac.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
           COALESCE(ac.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
           COALESCE(ac.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
           COALESCE(ac.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance
    FROM owner_profile op
    LEFT JOIN card_counts cc ON cc.account_id = op.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_summary ls ON ls.account_id = op.account_id
    LEFT JOIN activity ac ON ac.account_id = op.account_id
)
SELECT account_id,
       opened_date,
       gender,
       owner_age,
       card_count,
       loan_count,
       loan_standing,
       transaction_count,
       money_in,
       money_out,
       peak_balance,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM profile
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id;

WITH qualified AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id, d.account_id
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN card AS c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.type = 'classic'
),
district_summary AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT q.client_id) AS client_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_amount
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN qualified AS q ON q.account_id = a.account_id
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = q.account_id
       AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
external_targets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id, t.bank, t.account
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN qualified AS q ON q.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = q.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND t.account IS NOT NULL
),
target_counts AS (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS external_account_count
    FROM external_targets
    GROUP BY district_id
)
SELECT
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COALESCE(s.client_count, 0) AS client_count,
    COALESCE(tc.external_account_count, 0) AS external_account_count,
    COALESCE(s.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount
FROM district AS d
LEFT JOIN district_summary AS s ON s.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN target_counts AS tc ON tc.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, district_name ASC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date < '1930-01-01'
) AS branch_districts
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = branch_districts.district_id;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(A11), 2)
FROM district
WHERE district_id IN (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date < '1950-01-01'
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS avg_district_salary
FROM district AS d
WHERE d.district_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.amount < 100000
      AND l.status = 'C'
);

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * (CAST(r853.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) - CAST(r854.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL))
    / CAST(r854.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL),
    2
) AS percentage_higher
FROM results AS r853
JOIN results AS r854 ON r854.driverId = r853.driverId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r853.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Paul'
  AND d.surname = 'di Resta'
  AND r853.raceId = 853
  AND r854.raceId = 854;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.position <> 1 OR r.position IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage_not_victories
FROM results AS r
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND ra.year >= 2010;

WITH win_counts AS (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS race_wins
    FROM results
    WHERE positionOrder = 1
    GROUP BY driverId
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY race_wins DESC) AS win_rank
    FROM win_counts
)
SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.nationality,
    MAX(ds.points) AS highest_standings_points
FROM ranked w
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = w.driverId
LEFT JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.driverId = w.driverId
WHERE w.win_rank = 1
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality;

WITH race AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 1988 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
full_distance AS (
    SELECT res.positionOrder, res.milliseconds
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN race ON race.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.laps = (
        SELECT MAX(r.laps)
        FROM results AS r
        JOIN race ON race.raceId = r.raceId
    )
      AND res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * (
        MAX(CASE WHEN positionOrder = 4 THEN milliseconds END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN positionOrder = 1 THEN milliseconds END)
    ) / MAX(CASE WHEN positionOrder = 4 THEN milliseconds END),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM full_distance;

SELECT
    r.year,
    (
        (SUM(res.milliseconds) / (10 * COUNT(*))
         + CASE
             WHEN 2 * (SUM(res.milliseconds) % (10 * COUNT(*))) >= 10 * COUNT(*)
             THEN 1
             ELSE 0
           END) / 100.0
    ) AS mean_elapsed_time_seconds
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res
    ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year < 1975
  AND res.positionOrder = 1
  AND res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.dob < '1985-01-01' AND res.laps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS ra ON res.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005;

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS score
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = res.constructorId
WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2008
  AND c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY q.q3 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    c.name,
    printf(
        '%d:%02d.%03d',
        MIN(l.milliseconds) / 60000,
        (MIN(l.milliseconds) % 60000) / 1000,
        MIN(l.milliseconds) % 1000
    ) AS fastest_lap_time
FROM circuits AS c
JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN lapTimes AS l ON l.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
  AND l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.name
ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(pit_stops), 2) AS average_pit_stops_per_race
FROM (
    SELECT r.raceId, COUNT(p.stop) AS pit_stops
    FROM races AS r
    LEFT JOIN pitStops AS p
        ON p.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM races AS r00
          WHERE r00.year = 2000
            AND r00.circuitId = r.circuitId
      )
    GROUP BY r.raceId
);

WITH q1_times AS (
    SELECT
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        q.q1,
        CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
        + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
        + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS elapsed_ms
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE r.year = 1995
      AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
      AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
      AND q.q1 <> ''
)
SELECT forename, surname, q1
FROM q1_times
WHERE elapsed_ms = (SELECT MIN(elapsed_ms) FROM q1_times);

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 = (
    SELECT MIN(q2)
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE raceId = r.raceId
      AND q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND q2 <> ''
  );

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS runner_up_count
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND res.position = 2
GROUP BY d.forename
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) >= 2
ORDER BY runner_up_count DESC, d.forename ASC;

SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    printf(
        '%02d:%02d:%02d.%03d',
        (CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
         + CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
         + CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER)
         + res.milliseconds / 1000 + 14400) / 3600 % 24,
        (CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
         + CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
         + CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER)
         + res.milliseconds / 1000 + 14400) / 60 % 60,
        (CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
         + CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
         + CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER)
         + res.milliseconds / 1000 + 14400) % 60,
        res.milliseconds % 1000
    ) AS finish_local_time,
    d.url
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
  AND res.positionOrder = 1;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND (q.q3 IS NULL OR q.q3 = '');

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        q.driverId,
        q.q2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY q.q2) AS time_rank
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
      AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND q.q2 <> ''
)
SELECT d.nationality
FROM eligible AS e
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = e.driverId
WHERE e.time_rank = 2
ORDER BY d.nationality;

SELECT c.name, c.location, c.country, r.year, p.duration
FROM pitStops AS p
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE p.milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM pitStops);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE d.code IS NULL
  AND d.forename IN (
      SELECT forename
      FROM drivers
      GROUP BY forename
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
  )
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL) > 120;

SELECT
    d.driverRef,
    COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM lapTimes AS lt
            WHERE lt.driverId = r.driverId
              AND lt.raceId = r.raceId
        ) THEN r.points ELSE 0 END
    ), 0) AS total_points
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN results AS r
    ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Robert'
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.driverRef
ORDER BY d.driverRef;

WITH driver_fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT raceId, driverId, MIN(milliseconds) AS fastest_lap_ms
    FROM lapTimes
    WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY raceId, driverId
)
SELECT
    r.date,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    CASE
        WHEN f.fastest_lap_ms IS NOT NULL THEN
            printf(
                '%d:%02d.%03d',
                f.fastest_lap_ms / 60000,
                (f.fastest_lap_ms % 60000) / 1000,
                f.fastest_lap_ms % 1000
            )
    END AS fastest_lap_time
FROM races AS r
LEFT JOIN driver_fastest_laps AS f
    ON f.raceId = r.raceId
   AND f.fastest_lap_ms > 90000
LEFT JOIN drivers AS d
    ON d.driverId = f.driverId
WHERE r.name = 'French Grand Prix'
  AND r.year >= 1990
ORDER BY r.date, d.surname, d.forename;

WITH italian_q3 AS (
    SELECT
        d.driverId,
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        MIN(q.q3) AS fastest_q3
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'Italian'
      AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
    GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
)
SELECT forename, surname, fastest_q3
FROM italian_q3
WHERE fastest_q3 = (SELECT MIN(fastest_q3) FROM italian_q3);

WITH eligible_q3 AS (
    SELECT
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name,
        r.name AS race_name,
        r.year AS race_year,
        q.q3 AS q3_time,
        CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
            + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS q3_seconds
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'British'
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) > 1980
      AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(q.q3) <> ''
)
SELECT full_name, race_name, race_year, q3_time
FROM eligible_q3
WHERE q3_seconds = (SELECT MIN(q3_seconds) FROM eligible_q3);

WITH driver_best AS (
    SELECT raceId, driverId, MIN(milliseconds) AS best_ms
    FROM lapTimes
    WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY raceId, driverId
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        raceId,
        driverId,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceId ORDER BY best_ms) AS lap_rank
    FROM driver_best
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM ranked r
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.lap_rank = 2
  AND d.dob >= '1976-01-01';

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
      + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
      = (
          SELECT MIN(
              CAST(substr(q2.q3, 1, instr(q2.q3, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
              + CAST(substr(q2.q3, instr(q2.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
          )
          FROM qualifying AS q2
          JOIN races AS r2 ON r2.raceId = q2.raceId
          WHERE r2.year = 2017
            AND r2.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
            AND q2.q3 <> ''
      );

WITH season_final AS (
    SELECT
        r.year,
        cs.constructorId,
        cs.points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY r.year, cs.constructorId
            ORDER BY r.round DESC, r.raceId DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM constructorStandings AS cs
    JOIN races AS r
        ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.constructorId,
        c.name,
        c.url,
        COALESCE(SUM(sf.points), 0) AS career_points
    FROM constructors AS c
    LEFT JOIN season_final AS sf
        ON sf.constructorId = c.constructorId
       AND sf.rn = 1
    WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian'
    GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.url
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        name,
        career_points,
        url,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS rank
    FROM totals
)
SELECT name, career_points, url
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY rank, name;

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename IN ('Peter', 'John')
  AND r.position = 1
GROUP BY d.forename
ORDER BY d.forename;

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE q.q3 = (
    SELECT MIN(q3)
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(q3) <> ''
);

SELECT
    c.nationality,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.rank = 1 THEN c.constructorId END) AS constructor_count
FROM constructors AS c
LEFT JOIN results AS r
    ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId
GROUP BY c.nationality
ORDER BY c.nationality;

SELECT
    s.year AS season,
    COUNT(ps.raceId) AS total_pit_stops
FROM seasons AS s
LEFT JOIN races AS r
    ON r.year = s.year
   AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM driverStandings AS ds
       JOIN drivers AS d
           ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
       WHERE ds.raceId = r.raceId
         AND d.nationality = 'Australian'
         AND ds.position BETWEEN 1 AND 19
   )
LEFT JOIN pitStops AS ps
    ON ps.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE s.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
GROUP BY s.year
ORDER BY s.year;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q1) <> ''
  AND (
    CAST(SUBSTR(q.q1, 1, INSTR(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
    + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q1, INSTR(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
  ) > 120;

WITH september_stops AS (
    SELECT ps.driverId, ps.raceId, ps.duration, ps.milliseconds
    FROM pitStops AS ps
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ps.raceId
    WHERE r.date >= '2016-09-01'
      AND r.date < '2016-10-01'
      AND ps.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
       s.duration AS pit_stop_time,
       r.name AS race_name,
       c.name AS circuit_name,
       c.location AS circuit_location
FROM september_stops AS s
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = s.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = s.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE s.milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM september_stops);

WITH winning_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.driverId,
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        d.dob,
        d.nationality
    FROM drivers AS d
    JOIN results AS res ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE res.position = 1
),
oldest_winner AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM winning_drivers
    ORDER BY dob ASC, forename COLLATE NOCASE ASC, surname COLLATE NOCASE ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_win AS (
    SELECT r.name, r.date
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    JOIN oldest_winner AS ow ON ow.driverId = res.driverId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    ORDER BY r.date ASC, r.name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
career_starts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceId) AS total_starts
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN oldest_winner AS ow ON ow.driverId = res.driverId
)
SELECT
    ow.forename || ' ' || ow.surname AS full_name,
    ow.nationality,
    fw.name AS first_race_won,
    fw.date AS first_win_date,
    cs.total_starts
FROM oldest_winner AS ow
CROSS JOIN first_win AS fw
CROSS JOIN career_starts AS cs;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS runnings
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status AS s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Accident';

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = q.constructorId
JOIN results AS res
  ON res.raceId = q.raceId
 AND res.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
ORDER BY q.q2 ASC, res.grid ASC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;

WITH valid_q2 AS (
    SELECT q.q2, d.surname, r.name AS race_name
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(q.q2) <> ''
),
fastest AS (
    SELECT MIN(q2) AS q2
    FROM valid_q2
)
SELECT v.surname, v.race_name
FROM valid_q2 AS v
JOIN fastest AS f ON v.q2 = f.q2;

SELECT d.number
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
    SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
    FROM qualifying AS q2
    WHERE q2.raceId = q.raceId
      AND q2.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

WITH q3_times AS (
    SELECT d.nationality, q.q3
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
      AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND q.q3 <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT nationality
FROM q3_times
WHERE q3 = (SELECT MIN(q3) FROM q3_times);

SELECT r.year AS season_year,
       CAST(SUBSTR(runner.time, 2) AS REAL) AS runner_up_time_gap_seconds
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS runner
  ON runner.raceId = r.raceId
 AND runner.positionOrder = 2
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
  AND r.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND r.time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.time ASC, r.year DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.code
FROM races AS r
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
ORDER BY d.code;

SELECT r.year, d.forename, d.surname, res.time
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017
  AND r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND r.time <= '17:00:00'
  AND res.positionOrder = 1
ORDER BY r.year;

WITH valid_races AS (
    SELECT circuitId, time
    FROM races
    WHERE time IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(time) <> ''
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT MIN(time) AS earliest_time,
           MAX(time) AS latest_time
    FROM valid_races
)
SELECT
    (
        SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ')
        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT c.circuitRef
            FROM valid_races r
            JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
            WHERE r.time = b.earliest_time
            ORDER BY c.circuitRef
        )
    ) AS earliest_circuit_refs,
    (
        SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ')
        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT c.circuitRef
            FROM valid_races r
            JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
            WHERE r.time = b.latest_time
            ORDER BY c.circuitRef
        )
    ) AS latest_circuit_refs,
    strftime('%s', '1970-01-01 ' || b.latest_time)
      - strftime('%s', '1970-01-01 ' || b.earliest_time) AS gap_seconds
FROM bounds b;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.dob >= '1980-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1991-01-01'
  AND r.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(r.fastestLapSpeed) <> ''
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY MAX(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) DESC,
         d.dob ASC,
         d.surname COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM races AS r
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q1 <> ''
  AND (q.q2 IS NULL OR q.q2 = '')
ORDER BY
  CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) DESC,
  CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL) DESC,
  q.driverId;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN s.status = 'Finished' OR s.status GLOB '+* Lap*' THEN x.driverId
    END) / COUNT(DISTINCT x.driverId),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM results x
JOIN status s ON s.statusId = x.statusId
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = x.raceId
WHERE r.year = 1957
  AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total), 2) AS mean_total_expense_per_event
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(ex.cost) AS event_total
    FROM expense AS ex
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = ex.link_to_member
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget
    WHERE m.first_name = 'Elijah'
      AND m.last_name = 'Allen'
      AND strftime('%m', ex.expense_date) IN ('09', '10')
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
);

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END), 0)
     - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END), 0)
       AS total_amount_difference
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id;

SELECT notes
FROM income
WHERE date_received = '2019-09-14'
  AND source = 'Fundraising';

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS name
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_event) > 7;

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e
  ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

WITH semester AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS head_count
    FROM event AS e
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
        ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
      AND e.event_date < '2019-12-01'
    GROUP BY e.event_id
),
target AS (
    SELECT SUM(head_count) AS head_count
    FROM semester
    WHERE event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
),
averages AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(head_count), 1) AS avg_count
    FROM semester
)
SELECT
    target.head_count AS womens_soccer_attendance,
    averages.avg_count AS fall_2019_average_attendance,
    CASE
        WHEN target.head_count > averages.avg_count THEN 'more'
        WHEN target.head_count < averages.avg_count THEN 'fewer'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS verdict
FROM target
CROSS JOIN averages;

WITH college_departments AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT department
    FROM major
    WHERE college = 'College of Engineering'
)
SELECT
    d.department,
    COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS total_dues
FROM college_departments AS d
LEFT JOIN major AS mj
    ON mj.department = d.department
   AND mj.college = 'College of Engineering'
LEFT JOIN "member" AS mem
    ON mem.link_to_major = mj.major_id
   AND mem.position = 'Member'
LEFT JOIN income AS i
    ON i.link_to_member = mem.member_id
   AND i.source = 'Dues'
   AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM attendance AS a
       WHERE a.link_to_member = mem.member_id
   )
GROUP BY d.department
ORDER BY d.department;

WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member, link_to_budget
    FROM expense
    WHERE cost > 50
      AND link_to_budget IS NOT NULL
),
line_balances AS (
    SELECT
        b.budget_id,
        b.amount - COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS remaining
    FROM budget AS b
    LEFT JOIN expense AS e
        ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY b.budget_id
)
SELECT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lb.remaining), 2) AS total_remaining
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN member AS m
    ON m.member_id = q.link_to_member
JOIN line_balances AS lb
    ON lb.budget_id = q.link_to_budget
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY total_remaining DESC, m.last_name, m.first_name;

SELECT ma.major_name, COUNT(*) AS number_of_majors
FROM major AS ma
LEFT JOIN member AS me
    ON me.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.college = 'College of Engineering'
GROUP BY ma.major_id, ma.major_name
HAVING COUNT(me.member_id) = 0;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 2)
FROM (
    SELECT b.link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM budget AS b
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
        ON a.link_to_event = b.link_to_event
    WHERE LOWER(b.category) = 'advertisement'
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
);

SELECT e.event_name, e.location, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS attendance_count
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Budget'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.location
ORDER BY e.event_name;

WITH major_attendance AS (
    SELECT m.major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM event e
    JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    JOIN member mem ON mem.member_id = a.link_to_member
    JOIN major m ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major
    WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game'
    GROUP BY m.major_id, m.major_name
)
SELECT major_name, attendee_count
FROM major_attendance
WHERE attendee_count = (SELECT MAX(attendee_count) FROM major_attendance)
ORDER BY major_name;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN m.position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officer'
        ELSE 'other student'
    END AS member_group,
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(a.events_attended, 0)), 2) AS average_events_attended_per_member
FROM member AS m
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT link_to_member, COUNT(*) AS events_attended
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_member
) AS a
    ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY member_group;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lower(trim(item.value)))
FROM budget AS b
JOIN expense AS x
  ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN json_each(
  '["' || replace(x.expense_description, ', ', '","') || '"]'
) AS item
WHERE b.amount - b.spent < 0;

WITH water_spending AS (
    SELECT
        b.link_to_event AS event_id,
        SUM(x.cost) AS water_cost
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN expense AS x
        ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE LOWER(x.expense_description) LIKE '%water%'
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
),
attendee_counts AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event AS event_id,
        COUNT(*) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
)
SELECT
    e.event_name,
    printf('%.2f', ROUND(COALESCE(ws.water_cost, 0) / ac.attendee_count, 2)) AS amount_spent_per_attendee
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendee_counts AS ac
    ON ac.event_id = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN water_spending AS ws
    ON ws.event_id = e.event_id;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN major.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS members_in_college,
    SUM(CASE WHEN major.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS members_not_in_college
FROM member
LEFT JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id;

WITH latest_vp_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date(e.expense_date)) AS expense_date
    FROM expense AS e
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
    WHERE m.position = 'Vice President'
)
SELECT l.expense_date,
       printf('%.2f', SUM(e.cost)) AS total_cost
FROM latest_vp_date AS l
JOIN expense AS e ON date(e.expense_date) = l.expense_date
GROUP BY l.expense_date;

SELECT e.type AS event_category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
  ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
GROUP BY e.type;

WITH college_counts AS (
  SELECT ma.college, COUNT(*) AS number_of_majors
  FROM "member" AS me
  JOIN major AS ma ON me.link_to_major = ma.major_id
  GROUP BY ma.college
)
SELECT college, number_of_majors
FROM college_counts
WHERE number_of_majors = (SELECT MAX(number_of_majors) FROM college_counts)
ORDER BY college;

WITH RECURSIVE qualifying_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event AS event_id
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount > 40
),
descriptions AS (
    SELECT e.location,
           x.expense_description || ',' AS remaining
    FROM qualifying_events AS q
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = q.event_id
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = q.event_id
    JOIN expense AS x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE x.expense_description IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT location,
           substr(remaining, instr(remaining, ',') + 1)
    FROM descriptions
    WHERE instr(remaining, ',') > 0
),
items AS (
    SELECT location,
           trim(substr(remaining, 1, instr(remaining, ',') - 1)) AS item
    FROM descriptions
    WHERE instr(remaining, ',') > 0
)
SELECT location,
       COUNT(DISTINCT item) AS number_of_things_bought
FROM items
WHERE item <> ''
GROUP BY location;

WITH pizza_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.link_to_event AS event_id
    FROM budget b
    JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE x.expense_description = 'Pizza'
)
SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budgeted
FROM event e
JOIN pizza_events p ON p.event_id = e.event_id
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
  AND e.event_date < '2019-10-01';

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id), 2) AS average_spent_per_event
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN budget AS b
  ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id;

WITH event_totals AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        SUM(COALESCE(b.amount, 0)) AS total_budget,
        SUM(COALESCE(b.spent, 0)) AS total_spending
    FROM event AS e
    LEFT JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
purchase_counts AS (
    SELECT
        et.event_id,
        COALESCE(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN x.expense_id IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 1 + length(x.expense_description)
                             - length(replace(x.expense_description, ',', ''))
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ),
            0
        ) AS purchase_count
    FROM event_totals AS et
    LEFT JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.link_to_event = et.event_id
    LEFT JOIN expense AS x
        ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY et.event_id
)
SELECT et.event_name
FROM event_totals AS et
JOIN purchase_counts AS pc
    ON pc.event_id = et.event_id
WHERE et.total_spending <= et.total_budget
ORDER BY pc.purchase_count DESC, et.event_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT e.type, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS members
    FROM event AS e
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
        ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
      AND e.event_date < '2020-06-01'
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type, members
FROM totals
WHERE members = (SELECT MAX(members) FROM totals);

SELECT
    TRIM(item) AS item_name,
    b.category AS budget_category,
    SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
FROM expense AS e
JOIN budget AS b
    ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
JOIN event AS ev
    ON ev.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        expense_id,
        TRIM(value) AS item
    FROM expense,
         json_each(
             '["' || REPLACE(REPLACE(expense_description, '"', '\\"'), ', ', '","') || '"]'
         )
) AS items
    ON items.expense_id = e.expense_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting'
  AND e.approved = 'true'
GROUP BY TRIM(item), b.category
ORDER BY b.category, item_name;

SELECT
    e.event_name,
    e.event_date,
    COALESCE(b.total_budget, 0) AS total_amount_budgeted,
    COALESCE(a.attendee_count, 0) AS number_of_members_attended
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS total_budget
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
) AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
) AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
ORDER BY e.event_name ASC, e.event_date ASC;

WITH RECURSIVE items(expense_id, rest, item) AS (
    SELECT e.expense_id,
           replace(e.expense_description, 'Bakery - ', '') || ',',
           ''
    FROM expense AS e
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
    WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha'
      AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'
      AND e.expense_description IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT expense_id,
           substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1),
           trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1))
    FROM items
    WHERE rest <> ''
)
SELECT item AS item_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT expense_id) AS times_bought
FROM items
WHERE item <> ''
GROUP BY item
ORDER BY item_name;

WITH RECURSIVE purchases AS (
    SELECT expense_id, link_to_member, cost, expense_description
    FROM expense
    WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
      AND expense_date < '2019-12-01'
),
split(expense_id, link_to_member, item, rest) AS (
    SELECT
        expense_id,
        link_to_member,
        trim(CASE
            WHEN instr(expense_description, ',') > 0
                THEN substr(expense_description, 1, instr(expense_description, ',') - 1)
            ELSE expense_description
        END),
        CASE
            WHEN instr(expense_description, ',') > 0
                THEN substr(expense_description, instr(expense_description, ',') + 1)
            ELSE ''
        END
    FROM purchases
    WHERE expense_description IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        expense_id,
        link_to_member,
        trim(CASE
            WHEN instr(rest, ',') > 0
                THEN substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1)
            ELSE rest
        END),
        CASE
            WHEN instr(rest, ',') > 0
                THEN substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1)
            ELSE ''
        END
    FROM split
    WHERE rest <> ''
),
kinds AS (
    SELECT link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT lower(item)) AS kind_count
    FROM split
    WHERE item <> ''
    GROUP BY link_to_member
),
spending AS (
    SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_spending
    FROM purchases
    GROUP BY link_to_member
),
stats AS (
    SELECT k.link_to_member, k.kind_count, s.total_spending
    FROM kinds AS k
    JOIN spending AS s USING (link_to_member)
)
SELECT
    m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
    stats.kind_count,
    stats.total_spending
FROM stats
JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = stats.link_to_member
WHERE stats.kind_count = (SELECT MAX(kind_count) FROM stats);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.major_name) AS different_majors
FROM member AS mem
JOIN major AS m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
WHERE m.department = 'Political Science Department';

WITH colour_counts AS (
    SELECT c.colour, COUNT(*) AS hero_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
    JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND c.colour IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(c.colour) <> ''
      AND c.colour <> 'No Colour'
    GROUP BY c.colour
)
SELECT
    colour,
    hero_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hero_count DESC) AS rank
FROM colour_counts
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, colour ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength';

SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Neutral' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS neutral_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Neutral' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neutral_marvel_count
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

WITH publisher_counts AS (
    SELECT p.publisher_name, COUNT(s.id) AS superhero_count
    FROM publisher AS p
    JOIN superhero AS s ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics')
    GROUP BY p.id, p.publisher_name
)
SELECT
    publisher_name,
    superhero_count,
    superhero_count - (SELECT MIN(superhero_count) FROM publisher_counts) AS difference
FROM publisher_counts
WHERE superhero_count = (SELECT MAX(superhero_count) FROM publisher_counts);

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour'
ORDER BY s.superhero_name;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180;

SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name
FROM superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p
  ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN colour AS eye
  ON s.eye_colour_id = eye.id
JOIN colour AS hair
  ON s.hair_colour_id = hair.id
JOIN colour AS skin
  ON s.skin_colour_id = skin.id
WHERE s.eye_colour_id = s.hair_colour_id
  AND s.hair_colour_id = s.skin_colour_id
  AND lower(eye.colour) NOT IN ('unknown', 'no colour');

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
LEFT JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT CASE
         WHEN dc_count = marvel_count THEN 'Tie'
         WHEN dc_count > marvel_count THEN 'DC Comics'
         ELSE 'Marvel Comics'
       END AS publisher,
       CASE
         WHEN dc_count = marvel_count THEN 0
         ELSE ABS(dc_count - marvel_count)
       END AS difference
FROM (
    SELECT
        COUNT(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 END) AS dc_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 END) AS marvel_count
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM (
    SELECT hp.power_id
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    GROUP BY hp.power_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM hero_power AS ss_hp
            JOIN superpower AS ss ON ss.id = ss_hp.power_id
            WHERE ss_hp.hero_id = hp.hero_id
              AND ss.power_name = 'Super Strength'
        ) THEN hp.hero_id
    END) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM hero_power AS ss_hp
            JOIN superpower AS ss ON ss.id = ss_hp.power_id
            WHERE ss_hp.hero_id = hp.hero_id
              AND ss.power_name = 'Super Strength'
        ) THEN hp.hero_id
    END) = 0
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 1) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE LOWER(c.colour) = 'green'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH power_counts AS (
    SELECT sp.power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT h.id) AS hero_count
    FROM superhero AS h
    JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = h.publisher_id
    JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
    JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND h.full_name IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(h.full_name) NOT IN ('', '-')
    GROUP BY sp.id, sp.power_name
)
SELECT power_name, hero_count
FROM power_counts
WHERE hero_count = (SELECT MAX(hero_count) FROM power_counts);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT ha2.attribute_value
      FROM superhero AS s2
      JOIN hero_attribute AS ha2 ON ha2.hero_id = s2.id
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE s2.superhero_name = 'Abomination'
        AND a2.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  )
  AND s.weight_kg <> 0;

SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS INTEGER) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT ha_hulk.attribute_value
      FROM superhero AS h
      JOIN hero_attribute AS ha_hulk ON ha_hulk.hero_id = h.id
      JOIN attribute AS a_hulk ON a_hulk.id = ha_hulk.attribute_id
      WHERE h.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
        AND a_hulk.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  )
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg <> 0;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
    FROM superhero
    WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL
),
tallest AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM ranked
    WHERE height_rank <= 10
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id)
FROM tallest AS t
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = t.id
JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero
WHERE publisher_id = (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
)
AND (
    race_id IS NULL
    OR race_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM race
        WHERE race IS NULL OR TRIM(race) = '' OR race = '-'
    )
);

WITH cryokinesis_powers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE LOWER(sp.power_name) = 'cryokinesis'
),
cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN cryokinesis_powers cp ON cp.power_id = hp.power_id
),
power_counts AS (
    SELECT c.hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM cohort c
    JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = c.hero_id
    GROUP BY c.hero_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 1)
FROM power_counts;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(d.weight_kg AS REAL)))
FROM superhero AS d
WHERE d.publisher_id = 4
  AND d.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND d.eye_colour_id IN (
      SELECT m.eye_colour_id
      FROM superhero AS m
      WHERE m.publisher_id = 13
        AND m.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(height_cm), 1)
FROM superhero
WHERE race_id = 24
  AND height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND height_cm <> 0;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg)
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.race_id NOT IN (
      SELECT h.race_id
      FROM superhero AS h
      JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = h.gender_id
      WHERE LOWER(g.gender) = 'female'
        AND h.race_id IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS publisher_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE s.height_cm > 200
  AND p.publisher_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(p.publisher_name) <> ''
  AND p.publisher_name NOT IN ('George Lucas', 'J. R. R. Tolkien', 'J. K. Rowling');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND p.publisher_name <> 'DC Comics';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 1) AS average_weight_kg,
       COUNT(s.weight_kg) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg <> 0;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero AS target
WHERE target.publisher_id = (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'
)
  AND target.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM superhero AS other
      WHERE other.eye_colour_id = target.eye_colour_id
        AND other.publisher_id IS NOT NULL
        AND other.publisher_id <> target.publisher_id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg <> 0;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(ha.attribute_value), 1) AS average_intelligence
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value IS NOT NULL
  AND ha.hero_id IN (
      SELECT hp.hero_id
      FROM hero_power hp
      JOIN superpower p ON p.id = hp.power_id
      WHERE p.power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')
  );

SELECT
    g.gender,
    ROUND(1.0 * SUM(COALESCE(p.power_count, 0)) / COUNT(*), 2) AS average_powers_per_hero
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g
    ON g.id = s.gender_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
) AS p
    ON p.hero_id = s.id
WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) NOT IN ('', '-', 'Yurrd the Unknown', 'Krypto the Superdog')
  AND INSTR(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') > 0
GROUP BY g.gender;

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.height_cm <> 0 THEN CAST(s.height_cm AS REAL) END), 2) AS average_height_cm,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg <> 0 THEN CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL) END), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND c.colour = 'Green';

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(height_cm, 0)), 1) AS average_height_cm,
  ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(weight_kg, 0)), 1) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero
WHERE publisher_id = 5;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(h.height_cm), 1) AS average_height_cm
FROM superhero AS h
WHERE h.id <> (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man'
)
  AND h.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND h.height_cm <> 0
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      WHERE hp.hero_id = h.id
        AND hp.power_id IN (
            SELECT power_id
            FROM hero_power
            WHERE hero_id = (
                SELECT id
                FROM superhero
                WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man'
            )
        )
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH lightest AS (
    SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS weight_kg
    FROM superhero
    WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
      AND weight_kg > 0
),
hero_counts AS (
    SELECT h.id, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.power_name) AS power_count
    FROM superhero AS h
    JOIN lightest AS l ON h.weight_kg = l.weight_kg
    LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
    LEFT JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    GROUP BY h.id
)
SELECT MAX(power_count)
FROM hero_counts;

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name, s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
    FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
    JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
    WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  )
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '-';

WITH qualifying_eye_colours AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero AS h
    JOIN colour AS hair
        ON hair.id = h.hair_colour_id
       AND hair.colour = 'Brown'
    WHERE h.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT eye.colour AS eye_colour,
       COUNT(other.id) AS hero_count
FROM qualifying_eye_colours AS q
JOIN colour AS eye
    ON eye.id = q.eye_colour_id
LEFT JOIN superhero AS other
    ON other.eye_colour_id = q.eye_colour_id
   AND other.hair_colour_id IS NOT NULL
   AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM colour AS hair2
       WHERE hair2.id = other.hair_colour_id
         AND hair2.colour <> 'Brown'
   )
GROUP BY eye.colour
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '-'
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) LIKE '% %'
  AND s.full_name <> 'Howard (Last name unrevealed)';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN s.id END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT s.id),
    2
)
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

WITH target AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man'
),
target_powers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT power_id
    FROM hero_power
    WHERE hero_id IN (SELECT id FROM target)
),
matching_heroes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.weight_kg
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    JOIN target_powers AS tp ON tp.power_id = hp.power_id
    WHERE s.id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM target)
      AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2)
FROM matching_heroes;

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'No Colour' THEN 1 END)
    - COUNT(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 END)
FROM superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(L.ALB), 4) AS avg_alb
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.PLT > 400
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND P.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND date(p.Birthday, '+51 years') <= '2026-10-09';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID),
    2
)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

WITH rnp_tests AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        Date,
        RNP,
        `T-BIL`,
        CAST(RNP AS REAL) AS rnp_value
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
),
strongest_tests AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM rnp_tests
    WHERE rnp_value = (SELECT MAX(rnp_value) FROM rnp_tests)
),
highest_bilirubin AS (
    SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`) AS max_bilirubin
    FROM strongest_tests
    WHERE `T-BIL` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    s.`T-BIL` AS total_bilirubin,
    s.Date AS lab_test_date,
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    p.SEX AS sex,
    p.Birthday AS birthday
FROM strongest_tests AS s
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = s.ID
CROSS JOIN highest_bilirubin AS h
WHERE s.`T-BIL` = h.max_bilirubin;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday > '1960-01-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 10
  );

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Admission = '-'
      AND l.SSA IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.SSA)) NOT IN ('negative', '0', '')
),
patient_rnp AS (
    SELECT l.ID, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) AS titer
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN eligible AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(l.RNP) <> ''
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.RNP)) <> 'negative'
    GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT ID, titer
FROM patient_rnp
WHERE titer = (SELECT MAX(titer) FROM patient_rnp);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE TRIM(p.Diagnosis) = 'MCTD'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 5
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND TRIM(COALESCE(e.Diagnosis, '')) <> ''
        AND TRIM(e.Diagnosis) <> 'MCTD'
  );

WITH per_patient AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT l.Date) AS lab_dates
    FROM Patient p
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Examination e
          WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      )
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
)
SELECT SEX, ROUND(AVG(lab_dates), 2) AS average_lab_test_dates
FROM per_patient
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;

SELECT Admission AS care_setting, COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE CAST(Laboratory.RNP AS REAL) > 16
  AND Admission IN ('+', '-')
GROUP BY Admission
ORDER BY Admission;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL
      AND (l.HCT <= 29 OR l.HCT >= 52)
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 16
);

WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE REPLACE(
              REPLACE(
                  REPLACE(
                      REPLACE(
                          REPLACE(
                              REPLACE(Diagnosis, ' ', ','),
                              CHAR(11), ','
                          ),
                          CHAR(29), ','
                      ),
                      CHAR(30), ','
                  ),
                  CHAR(31), ','
              ),
              ',,', ','
          ) IN ('RA,SJS', 'SJS,RA')
       OR Diagnosis IN ('RA, SJS susp', 'SJS, RA susp')
),
patient_status AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM Laboratory AS l
            WHERE l.ID = p.ID
              AND l.PLT > 100
              AND l.PLT < 400
        ) AS has_normal_platelet
    FROM eligible_patients AS p
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(has_normal_platelet), 0) AS patients_with_normal_platelet,
    COUNT(*) - COALESCE(SUM(has_normal_platelet), 0) AS patients_never_with_normal_platelet
FROM patient_status;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(L.TP - 8.5), 3) AS average_deviation
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.TP > 8.5
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS E
      WHERE E.ID = L.ID
        AND E."Examination Date" = L.Date
        AND E.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  );

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')
  );

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN p.ID END) AS women,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN p.ID END) AS men
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 32;

SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS youngest_age
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) >= 64
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Thrombosis IS NOT NULL
        AND e.Thrombosis <> 0
  );

WITH patient_test_counts AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            (l.GOT IS NOT NULL) + (l.GPT IS NOT NULL) + (l.LDH IS NOT NULL) +
            (l.ALP IS NOT NULL) + (l.TP IS NOT NULL) + (l.ALB IS NOT NULL) +
            (l.UA IS NOT NULL) + (l.UN IS NOT NULL) + (l.CRE IS NOT NULL) +
            (l."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL) + (l."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL) +
            (l.TG IS NOT NULL) + (l.CPK IS NOT NULL) + (l.GLU IS NOT NULL) +
            (l.WBC IS NOT NULL) + (l.RBC IS NOT NULL) + (l.HGB IS NOT NULL) +
            (l.HCT IS NOT NULL) + (l.PLT IS NOT NULL) + (l.PT IS NOT NULL) +
            (l.APTT IS NOT NULL) + (l.FG IS NOT NULL) + (l.PIC IS NOT NULL) +
            (l.TAT IS NOT NULL) + (l.TAT2 IS NOT NULL) + (l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) +
            (l.IGG IS NOT NULL) + (l.IGA IS NOT NULL) + (l.IGM IS NOT NULL) +
            (l.CRP IS NOT NULL) + (l.RA IS NOT NULL) + (l.RF IS NOT NULL) +
            (l.C3 IS NOT NULL) + (l.C4 IS NOT NULL) + (l.RNP IS NOT NULL) +
            (l.SM IS NOT NULL) + (l.SC170 IS NOT NULL) + (l.SSA IS NOT NULL) +
            (l.SSB IS NOT NULL) + (l.CENTROMEA IS NOT NULL) + (l.DNA IS NOT NULL) +
            (l."DNA-II" IS NOT NULL)
        ), 0) AS test_count
    FROM Patient AS p
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE lower(p.Diagnosis) = 'psoriatic arthritis'
    GROUP BY p.ID
)
SELECT
    SUM(test_count) AS total_laboratory_tests,
    SUM(CASE WHEN test_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_no_laboratory_tests
FROM patient_test_counts;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Examination
WHERE date(`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND Thrombosis > 0;

SELECT e.Symptoms
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE (',' || REPLACE(p.Diagnosis, ', ', ',') || ',') LIKE '%,SLE,%'
  AND e.Thrombosis <> 0
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY e.Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, e.Symptoms ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN e.ID END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM Examination AS e
WHERE e.Thrombosis > 0;

WITH thrombosis_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Thrombosis > 0
),
first_examination AS (
    SELECT ID, MIN(julianday(`Examination Date`)) AS first_exam_jd
    FROM Examination
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(fe.first_exam_jd - julianday(p.`First Date`)))
FROM thrombosis_cohort AS tc
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = tc.ID
JOIN first_examination AS fe ON fe.ID = tc.ID
WHERE p.Admission LIKE '%+%'
  AND julianday(p.`First Date`) IS NOT NULL
  AND fe.first_exam_jd IS NOT NULL;

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date >= '1994-01-01'
  AND l.Date <= '1994-12-31'
  AND l.GOT < 60
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN p.ID END)
  - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN p.ID END)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.UN < 30
  );

SELECT
    p.SEX,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.CRE >= 1.5 THEN p.ID END) AS patients_with_out_of_range_creatinine,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS total_patients,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.CRE >= 1.5 THEN p.ID END)
        / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID),
        1
    ) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l
    ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX IN ('M', 'F')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY CASE p.SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

WITH group_max AS (
    SELECT p.Admission, MAX(l.`T-CHO`) AS highest_tcho
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
      AND l.`T-CHO` IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.Admission
)
SELECT gm.highest_tcho AS `T-CHO`, p.Admission, p.ID
FROM group_max AS gm
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.Admission = gm.Admission
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
                  AND l.`T-CHO` = gm.highest_tcho
ORDER BY CASE p.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END, p.ID;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, l.RNP AS anti_RNP_level
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p."First Date" >= '1991-01-01'
  AND p."First Date" < '1992-01-01'
  AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(l2.RNP AS INTEGER))
      FROM Patient AS p2
      JOIN Laboratory AS l2 ON l2.ID = p2.ID
      WHERE p2."First Date" >= '1991-01-01'
        AND p2."First Date" < '1992-01-01'
        AND l2.RNP IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT
    CASE p.Admission
        WHEN '+' THEN 'Hospital'
        WHEN '-' THEN 'Outpatient clinic'
    END AS care_setting,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND (
            CAST(l."U-PRO" AS REAL) >= 30
            OR l."U-PRO" IN ('+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=1000', '>=300')
        )
  )
GROUP BY p.Admission
ORDER BY CASE p.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.RF IN ('-', '+-')
  )
