  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND (e.KCT = '+' OR e.RVVT = '+' OR e.LAC = '+')
  );

WITH latest_lab AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
latest_scl AS (
    SELECT ID, SC170,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE SC170 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT l.ID
FROM latest_lab AS l
JOIN latest_scl AS s
  ON s.ID = l.ID
 AND s.rn = 1
WHERE l.latest_date > '1997-01-01'
  AND s.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.SSA IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.SSA)) NOT IN ('negative', '0')
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l."U-PRO")) NOT IN ('negative', 'none', '-', '0')
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) < 8;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission <> '-'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.ALP >= 300
  );

SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS INTEGER))
FROM Laboratory
WHERE CRE < 1.5
  AND RNP GLOB '[0-9]*';

SELECT CASE p.SEX WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' END AS sex,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.HGB < 7.0
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY CASE p.SEX WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END;

SELECT ID, Date, RNP
FROM Laboratory
WHERE GOT >= 60
  AND RNP GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GOT >= 60
      AND RNP GLOB '[0-9]*'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (
    (l.FG < 150 OR l.FG > 450)
    OR CASE
      WHEN TRIM(l."U-PRO") GLOB '>=*'
        THEN CAST(SUBSTR(TRIM(l."U-PRO"), 3) AS REAL) >= 300
      WHEN TRIM(l."U-PRO") IN ('3', '4')
        THEN 1
      WHEN TRIM(l."U-PRO") GLOB '[0-9]*'
           AND TRIM(l."U-PRO") NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'
        THEN CAST(TRIM(l."U-PRO") AS REAL) >= 300
      ELSE 0
    END
  );

SELECT
  CASE p.Admission
    WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
    WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
  END AS patient_group,
  COUNT(*) AS normal_lactate_dehydrogenase_measurements
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND p.Diagnosis LIKE '%APS%'
  AND l.LDH < 500
GROUP BY p.Admission
ORDER BY CASE p.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patients_with_lab_results,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM Laboratory l2
            WHERE l2.ID = p.ID
              AND l2."T-BIL" >= 2.0
        ) THEN p.ID
    END) AS patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.SEX IS NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Admission LIKE '+%'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1945 AND 1989
  AND e."ANA Pattern" = 'P';

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient AS p
    WHERE p.Admission = '-'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Laboratory AS l
          WHERE l.ID = p.ID
            AND l.HGB < 10
      )
),
patient_max AS (
    SELECT e.ID, e.SEX, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_rnp
    FROM eligible AS e
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = e.ID
    WHERE l.RNP GLOB '[0-9]*'
    GROUP BY e.ID, e.SEX
)
SELECT ID, SEX, highest_rnp
FROM patient_max
WHERE highest_rnp = (SELECT MAX(highest_rnp) FROM patient_max);

WITH first_lab AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        GOT,
        RNP,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM first_lab
WHERE rn = 1
  AND GOT < 60
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 10;

WITH ranked_proteinuria AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        Date,
        `U-PRO`,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ID
            ORDER BY Date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `U-PRO` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    rp.Date,
    rp.`U-PRO`
FROM ranked_proteinuria AS rp
JOIN Patient AS p
    ON p.ID = rp.ID
WHERE rp.rn = 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 0
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND e.Thrombosis = 0
);

WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) >= 16
),
patient_gpt AS (
    SELECT l.ID, MAX(l.GPT) AS highest_normal_gpt
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN eligible_patients AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.GPT < 60
    GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT p.Birthday
FROM patient_gpt AS g
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = g.ID
ORDER BY g.highest_normal_gpt DESC, g.ID ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Thrombosis > 0
  AND l.PT < 14
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 16;

WITH ranked_tests AS (
    SELECT
        l.ID,
        l.Date,
        CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) AS dna_level,
        p.Birthday,
        p.Diagnosis,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) DESC, l.Date ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.Admission = '+'
      AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%Y', Date) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', Date) < strftime('%m-%d', Birthday)) AS age,
    Diagnosis
FROM ranked_tests
WHERE rn = 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l."T-BIL" >= 1.2
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM json_each('["' || replace(p.Diagnosis, ', ', '","') || '"]') AS d
    WHERE trim(d.value) = 'SLE'
)
ORDER BY p.SEX, p.ID;

WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        CASE Admission
            WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
            WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
        END AS care_setting
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'F'
      AND Admission IN ('+', '-')
      AND Birthday <= date('2026-10-09', '-50 years')
),
patient_results AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.care_setting,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_elevated_rnp
    FROM eligible_patients AS p
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.care_setting
)
SELECT
    care_setting,
    SUM(has_elevated_rnp) AS patients_with_elevated_anti_rnp,
    COUNT(*) - SUM(has_elevated_rnp) AS patients_without_elevated_anti_rnp
FROM patient_results
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting;

WITH latest_igg AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        IGG,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE IGG IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN latest_igg AS l
    ON l.ID = p.ID
   AND l.rn = 1
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.IGG >= 2000;

WITH sle_patients AS (
    SELECT ID, Diagnosis
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
      AND replace(Diagnosis, 'SLE susp', '') LIKE '%SLE%'
),
ranked_results AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.Diagnosis, l.DNA,
           MAX(CAST(l.DNA AS REAL)) OVER () AS highest_result
    FROM sle_patients AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE l.DNA IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ID, Diagnosis, DNA AS highest_anti_DNA_result
FROM ranked_results
WHERE CAST(DNA AS REAL) = highest_result;

WITH latest_igg AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        IGG,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE IGG IS NOT NULL
),
settings AS (
    SELECT '+' AS admission, 'admitted to the hospital' AS setting
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '-', 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
)
SELECT
    s.setting,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.IGG > 900 AND l.IGG < 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*),
        1
    ) AS percentage
FROM settings AS s
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.Admission = s.admission
LEFT JOIN latest_igg AS l ON l.ID = p.ID AND l.rn = 1
GROUP BY s.admission, s.setting
ORDER BY CASE s.admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        RNP,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT COALESCE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END),
    0
)
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = r.ID
WHERE r.rn = 1
  AND CAST(r.RNP AS REAL) >= 32
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M');

WITH ranked_rnp AS (
    SELECT
        l.ID,
        l.RNP,
        l.CPK,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY l.ID
            ORDER BY l.Date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
      AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM ranked_rnp
WHERE rn = 1
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 64
  AND CPK < 250;

WITH confirmed AS (
    SELECT ID, Admission
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
      AND Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SLE susp%'
)
SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS inpatients,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS outpatients,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission IN ('+', '-') THEN ID END), 0),
        2
    ) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM confirmed;

SELECT SEX, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
  )
GROUP BY SEX;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE "First Date" BETWEEN '1998-02-15' AND '1998-02-28'
  AND Admission LIKE '+%'
ORDER BY (julianday("First Date") - julianday(Birthday)) DESC, ID ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(`aCL IgM`), 1) AS average_acl_igm
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1993-10-01' AND '1993-10-31'
  AND Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%';

WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RBC < 3.5
),
patient_ages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.Admission,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
        - (
            strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)
        ) AS age
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN eligible_patients AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
)
SELECT
    Admission,
    COUNT(*) AS patient_count,
    ROUND(AVG(age), 1) AS average_age
FROM patient_ages
GROUP BY Admission
ORDER BY Admission;

SELECT SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory USING (ID)
WHERE SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY CASE SEX WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.`aCL IgM`), 2) AS avg_acl_igm
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE (',' || REPLACE(p.Diagnosis, ', ', ',') || ',') LIKE '%,SJS,%'
  AND (',' || REPLACE(p.Diagnosis, ', ', ',') || ',') NOT LIKE '%,SJS susp,%'
  AND e.`aCL IgM` IS NOT NULL
  AND e.`aCL IgM` <> 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SjS%'
  AND e.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SjS susp%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND (LOWER(TRIM(l.RNP)) = 'negative' OR TRIM(l.RNP) = '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS l
WHERE l.SM IN ('negative', '0')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS p
      WHERE p.ID = l.ID
        AND (
            CAST(p."U-PRO" AS REAL) >= 30
            OR p."U-PRO" IN ('+1(30)', '+2(100)', '+3', '+4', '>=300', '>=1000')
        )
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = l.ID
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = l.ID
        AND e.Thrombosis = 1
  );

WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.ID,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
        - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) >= 64
      AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(age), 1)
FROM eligible_patients
WHERE age < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.WBC > 3.5
  AND l.WBC < 9.0
  AND (l.FG <= 150 OR l.FG >= 450)
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1986-12-31'
  AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  AND l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
  AND l."U-PRO" NOT IN ('0', '-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) < 50;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4)
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(a.element) = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oxygen_count
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = '-'
    ) AS single_bond_molecules
      ON single_bond_molecules.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN atom AS a
      ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
);

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count)
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS single_bond_count
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
);

WITH element_counts AS (
    SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS atom_occurrences
    FROM atom
    JOIN molecule USING (molecule_id)
    WHERE label = '-'
    GROUP BY element
)
SELECT element
FROM element_counts
WHERE atom_occurrences = (SELECT MIN(atom_occurrences) FROM element_counts);

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'i' THEN a.atom_id END) AS iodine_atoms,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 's' THEN a.atom_id END) AS sulfur_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND a.element IN ('i', 's');

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM atom a
        WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
          AND LOWER(a.element) = 'f'
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT
  (SELECT bond_type
   FROM bond
   WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
   GROUP BY bond_type
   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, bond_type
   LIMIT 1) AS bond_type,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010') = '+' THEN 'YES'
    ELSE 'NO'
  END AS carcinogenic;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '#'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element IN ('p', 'br')
);

WITH qualifying_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(a.element) = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    4
)
FROM atom AS a
JOIN qualifying_molecules AS q
    ON a.molecule_id = q.molecule_id;

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(element) = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS hydrogen_fraction,
  (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006') AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE WHEN a1.atom_id < a2.atom_id THEN a1.atom_id ELSE a2.atom_id END AS atom_low,
    CASE WHEN a1.atom_id < a2.atom_id THEN a2.atom_id ELSE a1.atom_id END AS atom_high
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  WHERE m.label = '+'
    AND b.bond_type = '='
    AND a1.element = 'c'
    AND a2.element = 'c'
);

WITH plus_atoms AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
    FROM atom AS a
    JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
),
bonded_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id FROM connected
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected
),
bonded_counts AS (
    SELECT p.element, COUNT(*) AS bonded_count
    FROM plus_atoms AS p
    JOIN bonded_atoms AS b ON b.atom_id = p.atom_id
    GROUP BY p.element
),
winners AS (
    SELECT element
    FROM bonded_counts
    WHERE bonded_count = (SELECT MAX(bonded_count) FROM bonded_counts)
)
SELECT
    w.element,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.element = w.element THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM winners AS w
CROSS JOIN plus_atoms AS p
GROUP BY w.element;

SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    CASE m.label WHEN '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN '-' THEN 'NO' END AS carcinogenic,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
          AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
    ) AS number_of_multiple_bonds
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR041_10';

WITH types(bond_type) AS (
    VALUES ('-'), ('='), ('#')
),
cc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.bond_type
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE m.label = '+'
      AND a1.element = 'c'
      AND a2.element = 'c'
)
SELECT types.bond_type, COUNT(cc.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM types
LEFT JOIN cc ON cc.bond_type = types.bond_type
GROUP BY types.bond_type
ORDER BY CASE types.bond_type
    WHEN '-' THEN 1
    WHEN '=' THEN 2
    WHEN '#' THEN 3
END;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT neighbor.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom sulfur ON sulfur.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = sulfur.molecule_id
JOIN atom neighbor ON neighbor.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE sulfur.element = 's'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
      AND a.element IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM atom AS other
        WHERE other.element = a.element
          AND other.molecule_id <> b.molecule_id
      )
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS molecule_count
FROM molecule m
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM atom n
  WHERE n.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    AND n.element = 'n'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM atom n
  JOIN connected c
    ON c.atom_id = n.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = n.atom_id
  JOIN bond b
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  WHERE n.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    AND n.element = 'n'
    AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id2
    WHEN b.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id
END) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS b ON b.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.element = 'cl' OR b.element = 'cl';

WITH triple_bond_compounds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '#'
)
SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS carcinogenic_percent,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS non_carcinogenic_percent
FROM triple_bond_compounds AS t
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = t.molecule_id
WHERE m.label IN ('+', '-');

WITH atom_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM bond
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
carbon_touching AS (
    SELECT
        b.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS carbon_touching_bonds
    FROM bond AS b
    JOIN connected AS c
      ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom AS a
      ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE a.element = 'c'
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
        ac.number_of_atoms,
        COALESCE(bc.number_of_bonds, 0) AS number_of_bonds,
        ac.carbon_atoms AS number_of_carbon_atoms,
        ac.chlorine_atoms AS number_of_chlorine_atoms,
        COALESCE(ct.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS number_of_carbon_touching_bonds,
        COALESCE(bc.multiple_bonds, 0) AS number_of_multiple_bonds
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN atom_counts AS ac
      ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN bond_counts AS bc
      ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN carbon_touching AS ct
      ON ct.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE ac.carbon_atoms > 0
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY number_of_carbon_touching_bonds DESC,
                 number_of_atoms DESC,
                 molecule_id ASC
    ) AS rank,
    molecule_id,
    carcinogenicity_label,
    number_of_atoms,
    number_of_bonds,
    number_of_carbon_atoms,
    number_of_chlorine_atoms,
    number_of_carbon_touching_bonds,
    number_of_multiple_bonds
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS b ON b.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'y'
)
  AND (a.element = 'h' OR b.element = 'h');

WITH carbon_element_bonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         b.bond_id,
         CASE
           WHEN lower(a1.element) = 'c' THEN a2.element
           ELSE a1.element
         END AS element
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  WHERE m.label = '-'
    AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
    AND (lower(a1.element) = 'c' OR lower(a2.element) = 'c')
)
SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
FROM carbon_element_bonds
GROUP BY element;

SELECT molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE label = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND LOWER(a.element) IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
  )
ORDER BY molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT e.element AS element,
       COALESCE(q.atom_count, 0) AS atom_count
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom) AS e
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM connected AS c
        JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
        WHERE (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
          AND b.bond_type = '-'
    )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM connected AS c
        LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
        WHERE (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
          AND (b.bond_type IS NULL OR b.bond_type <> '-')
    )
    GROUP BY a.element
) AS q ON q.element = e.element
ORDER BY e.element;

WITH triple_bond_elements AS (
    SELECT a.element
    FROM bond b
    JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'

    UNION

    SELECT a.element
    FROM bond b
    JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
)
SELECT
    t.element AS element_symbol,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM triple_bond_elements t
JOIN atom a ON a.element = t.element
GROUP BY t.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;

SELECT
    a.element AS element_symbol,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN c.atom_id IS NOT NULL OR c.atom_id2 IS NOT NULL THEN a.atom_id
    END) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
LEFT JOIN connected AS c
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;
